articleTitle: Silva and Marcos' Digital Data Collection Approach for Unconventional Superstructural Components
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Retrofitting of superstructural components (SCs) is very important in order to strengthen and prolong their useability however, the appearance of SCs becomes unconventional. Due to the retrofitting results, the strength of unconventional superstructural components (USCs) could not be predicted by the codes and standards. This study gives insight into how to predict the strength of USCs using an artificial neural network (ANN). The dataset of ANN training was digitally collected from the model simulation of the finite element method (FEM). Moreover, sensitivity analysis (SA) was performed to evaluate the variables. This study presents a generalized methodology and results. Utilizing a synthesis of the FEM for a set of data, the ANN for forecasting, and the SA for assessment would benefit to the Industry 4.0 transition and digital transformation.

articleTitle: Image Classification Based on Quantum Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Nowadays, using machine learning for image classification is very common. However, due to the increasing demand for data processing and fast computing, the idea of enhancing machine learning with quantum computing has been proposed, known as quantum machine learning (QML). Quantum machine learning has the advantages of higher efficiency and accuracy. Quantum computing uses quantum bits (qubits) for data storage and computing, where a qubit can represent quantum states |0〉and |1〉simultaneously, enabling the processing of information for two states simultaneously, which is unparalleled in classical computing. Moreover, quantum machine learning can handle more complex data and process data faster. In classical machine learning, the processing of large-scale data and complex problems often faces problems of high computational complexity and low algorithm efficiency. Quantum computing can handle multiple computing tasks simultaneously, achieving faster computing. Therefore, in some scenarios that require efficient computing, quantum machine learning may be the best choice. In this study, we simulated quantum circuits using Qiskit and built a hybrid quantum-classical neural network model using VQNet to classify MNIST handwritten digits and CIFAR-10 datasets. The experiments showed that quantum machine learning has the advantages of efficiency, accuracy, and security over classical machine learning, which may be an improvement over classical machine learning. This research proposes a machine learning algorithm based on quantum computing, which promotes the development of quantum computing and quantum technology. At the same time, it provides a new solution and idea for image classification, enabling people to pursue faster and more accurate quantum machine learning instead of being limited to classical machine learning.<sup>[1]</sup>

articleTitle: Steel Surface Defect Detection Based on an Improved YOLOv5 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Surface defect detection is critical in the process of steel manufacturing. To address the issues of low detection accuracy, slow speed, and low level of intelligence in the detection of steel surface defects, this paper proposes a steel surface defect detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv5 model. Firstly, the OSA-C3 (One-Shot Aggregation cross stage partial network with 3 convolutions) module is proposed to replace the C3 module in the backbone network, which enhances the model's feature extraction capability through one-shot aggregation. Secondly, The BiC-PAN (Bidirectional Cascade Path Aggregation Network) structure significantly enhances feature fusion with little parameter increase. Finally, the Coordinate Attention (CA) mechanism is introduced into the network to further improve the model's detection performance. Experiments demonstrate that the mean average precision (mAP) of the proposed algorithm is 79.1% on the NEU-DET dataset. Additionally, the average detection speed of the proposed model is 95 frame per second, which balances the detection accuracy and detection efficiency well.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Security Protection of zero-trust Smart Grid Based on Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes a fog computing assisted zero-trust smart grid terminal security protection mechanism. Specifically, the fog computing nodes are deployed around the terminal devices to relieve the computing pressure of cloud nodes. A trust evaluation mechanism considering historical behavior and device access delay is designed to quantify the terminal access request behavior into trust value. Elliptic curve cryptography algorithm (ECC) is used to encrypt the data sent by the terminal and fog node, and the discrete logarithm dilemma of the algorithm is used to achieve identity authentication between “terminal, fog and cloud”. Paillier is used to encrypt and aggregate a large amount of data collected by power terminals. The simulation results show that the distributed deployment mode based on fog computing can effectively reduce the system load, and the behavior of abnormal terminals will significantly reduce the trust value.

articleTitle: UAV Mission Planning Based on Fish Swarm-ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Addressing the problem of how multiple drones can quickly reconnoiter target points in a complex environment. A task planning algorithm to improve the fish-colony hybrid algorithm is proposed. First of all, according to the reconnaissance requirements of different importance targets in complex environments, a mission planning model with the greatest reconnaissance benefit as the objective function is established. Second, the data is pre-searched by a simplified artificial fish swarm algorithm, the initial pheromone distribution is generated, and the pheromone is passed into the improved ant colony algorithm to solve the model. Experimental simulation proves that the algorithm can solve the problem of task allocation and path planning in an integrated manner, and the convergence speed and global optimization ability of the traditional ant colony algorithm are improved.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Detection Based on Improved Yolov7
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Traffic sign detection in the natural environment with small targets, weak light and other influencing factors often make the neural network has low accuracy in the detection process. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv7-WCN network based on YOLOv7. Firstly, the improvement of the YOLOv7 network is added to the backbone network to enrich the image information In terms of improvements to the YOLO v7 network, CHB module is added to the backbone network in order to enrich the image information. Then, the normalization-based attention module (NAM) is introduced to make the network pay more attention to the target region for the purpose of enhancement. Moreover, the CIOU loss function of YOLOv7 is replaced with the Wasserstein Distance Loss to optimize the algorithm training process. Experimental results show that the detection accuracy of YOLOv7-WCN improves from 85.5% to 89.0% compared with the original algorithm, which is 3.5 percentage points better.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Mixed Sources Localization Algorithm Without Spectral Peak Search
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Based on high-order cumulant (HOC) and root-MUSIC theory, a mixed sources localization algorithm with low complexity is presented in this paper. Although having strong estimation performance, the majority of the existing localization algorithm have a heavy computational burden. The presented algorithm successfully reduces the computational burden by substituting the polynomial rooting for multiple signal classification (MUSIC) spectral peak searching. The roots of polynomial around the unit circle, which contains the Direction-of-Arrival (DOA) information of far-field source (FFS), are solved first. Then a HOC matrix is constructed, and the near-field source (NFS) component is extracted via matrix difference method. The DOA of NFS is obtained by combining the forward-backward spatial smoothing and polynomial rooting, and finally the NFS range parameter is estimated using the root MUSIC as well. The proposed algorithm effectively decreases the computational complexity by sacrificing a small part of the estimation performance within an acceptable range. The good estimation performance and low complexity are demonstrated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Binocular Stereo Vision Ranging Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to accurately obtain the distance information of the target, a target detection and distance measurement method based on an improved YOLOv5s model and binocular stereo vision fusion is proposed. First, the attention mechanism is introduced into the YOLOv5s model, and the comparison experiments show that the introduction of the ECA module improves the accuracy rate by 2.1%. Furthermore, by adding the SGBM-based binocular distance measurement algorithm to the YOLOv5s model, the distance of the target is calculated and given using the binocular parallax information during target detection. The experimental results show that the method measures the distance with less error, which provides technical support for many low-cost, non-contact ranging scenarios.

articleTitle: An Improved KNNG Driven Graph Transfer Diagnosis Method Via Edge Predictor
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: By establishing relationships between cross-domain samples, graph data-driven transfer diagnosis methods have achieved a great success. However, there are still some limitations: 1) Cross-domain relationships cannot be correctly established due to data distribution discrepancy, thereby degenerating graph quality; 2) Calculation of distance matrix consumes much computational cost. To overcome above limitations, an improved KNNG driven graph transfer diagnosis method via edge predictor is proposed. Firstly, few source-domain samples are used to construct initial K-nearest neighbor graph (IKNNG) for edge predictor training. Then, a pre-trained edge predictor, learning the graph construction strategy and restoring the graph structure of the input graph, directly outputs distance matrix without calculation of distance matrix. All the source-domain and target-domain samples are input to the pre-trained edge predictor, obtaining corresponding distance matrix. Based on the generated distance matrix, source-domain and target-domain samples are converted into source-domain and target-domain graphs, respectively. Both two kinds of graphs are used to train the Chebyshev graph convolutional network, achieving transfer diagnosis tasks. Comparative experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a competitive result.

articleTitle: Design of Semiconductor Laser Temperature Control System Based on Fuzzy Neural Network PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The paper describes a fuzzy-neural hybrid system to meet the rigorous requirement of the temperature control system of semiconductor laser. Fuzzy controller and neural network controller are used to optimize PID parameters respectively. Through MATLAB, we know that the system has superior performance than the conventional PID, reducing the maximum overshoot by 45.4%, the risetime by 0.504s, the peak time by 0.599s and the accommodation time by 2.047s.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Stability Control Method of SOFC Based on Fuzzy PI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) has the characteristics of multi input, multi output and strong coupling. In order to stabilize its output voltage, an efficient controller is designed, and its output voltage is controlled by the neuro fuzzy control method. Establish the mechanism model and neural network model of SOFC through mechanism analysis and experimental data fitting methods, and use fuzzy PI control strategy to control the output voltage of SOFC. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulation experiments, it was found that the error between the predicted voltage obtained by the SOFC fuzzy PI control model and the actual voltage is less than 0.008 V, which is more accurate than other mechanism models. The proposed control strategy can effectively control the output voltage of SOFC.

articleTitle: Design of High-Performance Battery Cover Flaw Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: We have designed and manufactured a high-performance, high-precision battery cover flaw detection system, which can automatically detect surface flaws of the battery cover and automatically separate qualified and unqualified products. In this article, we will briefly introduce the main components of this system, including the control unit, the image acquisition unit, the deep learning calculation unit, and the transport unit. Our equipment has been successfully applied to a battery cover equipment manufacturing factory. Compared with traditional manual inspection method, the production efficiency has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Continuous speech recognition based on DCNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In traditional speech recognition, the MFCC algorithm is commonly used as the feature extraction method, but this method is filtered by an artificially designed band-pass filter, which will cause information loss in the input signal. In this paper, the spectrogram is used as the extraction feature input to the network for training. This feature contains more original speech information and avoids the additional loss of information processing caused by the extraction algorithm. This paper models the acoustic model based on the neural convolutional network, proposes an acoustic model of the deep convolutional long short-term memory network (DCNN-LSTM), and explores the recognition effect of the network under three different feature inputs. Among the three different input features, the acoustic model trained by MFCC as the input feature has poor recognition effect, and the word error rate reaches 45.96<sup>%</sup>; Spectrogram as the input feature can significantly reduce the word error rate to 28.41%; after data enhancement SpeAugment has the best effect as a feature input, and can reduce the word error rate to 23.50% after improving the network model.

articleTitle: Design of Spindle Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor and Comparative Analysis of Different Core Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high loss and low efficiency of the spindle motor for machine tools in high-speed and high-frequency operation, the characteristics of high frequency and low loss of amorphous alloy materials are used to replace the traditional silicon steel sheet of motor, to reduce the core loss of motor and improve the efficiency of the motor. In this paper, a 20 kW high-speed spindle permanent magnet synchronous motor is taken as the research object. Combined with the characteristics of amorphous materials, the influence of different structural parameters on the performance of the motor is analyzed. The electromagnetic structure of the motor is designed, and the finite element analysis model of the electromagnetic field is established. The no-load condition and load condition of a motor are both simulated and analyzed, and the prototype is designed and manufactured. The correctness of the simulation results is verified, which provides a certain reference value for the application of amorphous alloy materials in the high-speed high-frequency motor.

Author Keywords: high speed permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Image Stitching Based on Optimized SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The article proposes an optimized SIFT algorithm to address the issue of uneven feature point distribution in the image stitching process, which leads to long feature point matching time and potential excessive overlap in the final panoramic image. After the feature points are extracted, the region of the feature points is divided by the image segmentation algorithm, make the number of feature points in the region less than the threshold value and then the feature points are matched. Additionally, the RANSAC algorithm is applied to eliminate incorrect matches. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm has significant advantages over the original method in terms of feature point matching time, accuracy, and final image quality.

articleTitle: Correction Unwrapping Algorithm Based on Phase Estimation for Undersampled Homodyne Interferometer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a correction undersampling unwrapping algorithm based on phase estimation is proposed. On the basis of direct unwrapping algorithm and the compensation period, the algorithm compensates the phase jump caused by undersampling. The calculation of compensation period is based on motion continuity and phase estimation. Meanwhile, integer ambiguity correction module avoids the accumulated phase error. The proposed algorithm is verified by simulations, which shows that the algorithm has high feasibility and accuracy, and can be applied to realize the displacement measurement of the undersampled homodyne interferometer.

articleTitle: Study on Working Condition Prediction of Suck Rod Pumping System Based on Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the complexity of downhole conditions, the fault diagnosis and prediction of suck rod pumping system have always been a hot issue of concern for oilfield staff. Currently, many researchers have done a lot of work on theoretical methods and practical applications of fault diagnosis, but there are few studies on fault prediction. Aiming at this problem, this article adopts the invariant moment theory to extract the eigenvalues of the dynamometer card, uses the eigenvalues of the dynamometer card as the prediction variables of the model. And achieves the forecasting of the changing trend of the working state of the suck rod pumping system through establishing a long short-term memory network prediction model. The results of the example analysis show that Mean Absolute Percentage Error is 1.144%, and the Mean Absolute Percentage Error is within the allowable range. This article presents a preliminary study on fault prediction for suck rod pumping systems, which has some guidance for practical application.

articleTitle: State Space Predictive Control for Quadrotors Cooperative Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper investigates the cooperative control of quadrotor formation. A state space predictive control strategy is proposed for the leader-following quadrotor cooperative flight. Specifically, based on the state predictive control method, a tracking controller is firstly designed for quadrotor leader to achieve the stable trajectory tracking. Secondly, a distributed state space predictive formation control law is established for quadrotor followers to keep the desired relative position with respect to the quadrotor leader. The proposed control scheme guarantees the overall stability of quadrotors cooperative control. Experiment results are provided, which verify the effectiveness of proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: The Early Warning Model of Dust Concentration in Smart Construction Sites Based on Long Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The air quality issue at the construction site of smart construction sites is a widely concerned issue among stakeholders. Regulating the emission of dust particles such as PM10 from construction sites is an effective measure to improve environmental quality. This paper proposes a smart construction dust particle concentration PM10 excess warning model based on LSTM neural network and time series processing methods, which achieves multi-step prediction by using predicted data as input for the next prediction. In the experiment, the dust data is first preprocessed as time series, then the LSTM model structure is adjusted to predict the PM10 concentration, and the predicted values are processed using a sliding window method. Depending on the warning threshold and conditions, the system warns 30 minutes before the exceedance of the standard.. Finally, the N-city smart construction PM10 dataset is used to implement online construction project supervision based on dust predictions. The RMSE, MAE and MAPE of the prediction model in this research were 3.60,1.61 and 1.87, respectively, with high accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Intelligent Greenhouse Automatic Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a major agricultural country, the smart agriculture and intelligent greenhouse technology started relatively late in China, and the existing agricultural equipment is also dilapidated. In such a large environment, developing automation systems that are responsive, reliable, low-cost, and fully functional is an inevitable demand for agricultural development in China. The development of high-level, intelligent, and forward-looking intelligent greenhouses has far-reaching significance. This article has developed an automatic control system and regulation scheme for the greenhouse environment with PLC as the control core. Through monitoring and feedback of key parameters in the greenhouse through sensors, PLC is used for program control and adjustment of control system. On the basis of meeting practical needs, fully automated greenhouse environment control and the goal of unmanned greenhouse management are all achieved, meeting the domestic environment and national conditions of China, and meeting the intelligent greenhouse management requirements of intelligent agriculture in China.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Composite Fault Based on SSA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at various compound faults that are easy to occur in photovoltaic substations, A photovoltaic array fault diagnosis model based on Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) and Long-term Memory Network (LSTM) is proposed. Firstly, the simulation model of photovoltaic substation is built and the fault characteristic parameters of photovoltaic array are extracted. Aiming at the Hyperparameter problem in LSTM, Sparrow search algorithm is used to optimize the 5-dimensional characteristic parameters of LSTM, and the optimal hyperparameter of LSTM is determined by optimization algorithm. The final experimental results show that the average accuracy of the proposed fault diagnosis model is 99.44%. Compared with the LSTM classifier model, it is improved by 5%, which verifies that this fault diagnosis model is superior to other models, and the proposed method can accurately and effectively improve the composite fault diagnosis performance of photovoltaic substation.

articleTitle: An Improved Sparsity Adaptive Matching Tracking Algorithm Based on SAMP
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Considering the shortcomings of the sparsity adaptive matching pursuit (SAMP) algorithm such as long reconstruction time and fixed step size, a weighted regularization variable step sparsity adaptive matching tracking (WRVS-SAMP) algorithm is proposed. The algorithm estimates the initial sparsity from the perspective of an atom matching test, Li weighted regularization is used to improve the accuracy of candidate atoms, and PCA is used to reduce the dimension of the candidate atom set matrix to reduce the interference of redundant information, the residual energy value of adjacent stages of signal reconstruction is compared with the pre-set threshold, and the step size and the termination iteration of the algorithm are adjusted adaptively to realize the accurate signal reconstruction. The simulation results show that the reconstruction accuracy of the improved algorithm is better than that of the SAMP algorithm, and the reconstruction rate is significantly improved.

articleTitle: sEMG Signal Denoising Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Wavelet Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The denoising of sEMG signals has always been a topic of exploration in the academic field. In this study, Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) is combined with wavelet threshold denoising (WT) to create the VMD-WT method. The sEMG signals from the NinaPro database, which have minimal noise, are used as clean signals. The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), root mean square error (RMSE), and coefficient of determination (R2) are utilized as evaluation metrics for denoising performance. The VMD-WT method is compared with traditional FIR filters, wavelet threshold (WT), empirical mode decomposition (EMD), and EMD-WT method. The results demonstrate that VMD-WT effectively achieves denoising of sEMG signals, and the performance of the VMD-WT method is superior in terms of the three evaluation metrics (SNR, RMSE, and R2). VMD-WT can be considered an effective method for denoising sEMG signals.

articleTitle: Improved Variable Step Size LMS Algorithm Based on Logarithmic Function
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: An improved variable step size LMS algorithm based on logarithmic function is proposed. By improving the nonlinear-function relationship between the step size and the error signal, this algorithm still keeps the step size in the convergence range even the processing is affected by large errors and strong interferences. Computer simulation indicates that the proposed algorithm not only has low steady-state error and fast convergence speed, but also overcome the defects of large divergence risk and low anti-interference capability in some algorithms.

articleTitle: Mechanical Analysis of Stable Platform for Rotary Steerable Drilling Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Stable platform is a typical mechanical and electrical integrated control system that servo control and inertia technology are combined, which is also the control core of rotary steerable system. Its structural stiffness determines whether the system can work normally or not. Therefore the structural principle of stable platform control shaft is introduced in this paper. Based on its structural characteristics and stress conditions, the mechanical analysis model and finite element model is obtained with some reasonable simplifications. Since downhole vibrating acceleration has a great impact on the stiffness of the control shaft, three typical acceleration states are given, acceleration perpendicular to the control shaft, downwards along the direction of the control shaft and upwards along the direction of the control shaft. The lateral and longitudinal stiffness of the model is analyzed by finite element method, results of which show that the vibrating acceleration no more than 15g is safe for the stable platform control shaft. The analytical results also show that the maximum displacement occurred on the upper end of the lower turbine generator. Through the analysis of this paper, the constraint conditions for the rotary steerable drilling tool are obtained and the theoretical basis for application of the tool structure is provided.

articleTitle: Intelligent Lost Circulation Monitoring with Unbalanced Data Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of intelligent lost circulation monitoring models with unbalanced data samples, a lost circulation monitoring method using the synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) and bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) network is proposed to efficiently explore the limited and unbalanced drilling data samples. Firstly, the SMOTE algorithm is applied to the field drilling data samples including 10299 data points to produce a new data set that includes 15154 data points. Then, a lost circulation monitoring model based on the Bi-LSTM network is established and trained using the balanced new data set. Experimental results demonstrate that the lost circulation recognition accuracy is improved from 88.93% to 98.38% by the proposed method compared with the widely used LSTM model with unbalanced data samples.

articleTitle: Frequency Diverse Array Antennas with Random Logarithmically Increasing Frequency Offset
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to its range-angle-dependent transmit beampattern, frequency diverse array (FDA) provides potential applications for physical layer secure communication. However, a standard FDA using linearly increasing frequency increments will generate range and angle-coupled S-shaped beampattern; i.e., eavesdropper which locate at other angle-range pairs can also effectively receive the confidential message.. This paper proposes a focused beampattern synthesis by employing random logarithmic frequency increments. Simulation results show the random logarithmic frequency array can form a point beam with more concentrated energy, lower sidelobe energy, and higher resolution in range and angle dimensions without increasing the system bandwidth.

articleTitle: Sea Surface Target Detection System and Ship Detection Dataset Based on Unmanned Surface Vessel
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To meet the needs of sea surface target detection based on Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV), this paper designs the sea surface target detection system including the process of data collection and transmission. Hardware selection, interface connection and transmission protocol are also clarified. Based on the USV target detection system, a visible light sea target detection dataset (STDetection) is collected for detection and classification, including 3115 images, with cutter, trawler, ship, drum, buoy, and pier category. The statistics of the distribution of the target occupying the ratio of the image and target size in the image are illustrated. We tested the performance of commonly adopted algorithms on the dataset, such as Faster-RCNN, Cascade-RCNN, SSD and YOLO series. This dataset provides a benchmark of sea target detection and classification for evaluating the performance of detection algorithm. The dataset is released at https://github.com/echo-sky/STDetection.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Deformation Monitoring Technology Based on Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar and Optical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study proposes a method for 3D deformation monitoring of surface targets. Firstly, the radial deformation information is obtained by radar, and the 2D deformation information in the vertical plane of radar line of sight is obtained by optical equipment. Then, based on multi-source image matching, the information fusion of radar deformation monitoring data and optical deformation monitoring data is realized. Finally, the deformation of the fused data is solved to obtain the 3D deformation of the target. The experimental results show that when there is a certain angle between the actual deformation direction of the target and the radial direction of the radar, the relative error of the deformation monitored by this method is obviously small, which can be reduced to less than 1/3 of the traditional radar monitoring error.

articleTitle: The Dehydration Rotation Speed Curve Extraction based on 3D Vibration Signals for Drum Washing Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: GB/T 4288-2018 requires that the sensors be installed on the shell of the washing machine to measure the vibration and displacement, and requires the sensor be installed on the drum to measure the speed. This measurement method is inefficient and has the risk of causing fault due to the second unpacking. To solve the above problem, an 3D acceleration sensor on the shell of a washing machine is used to extract the dehydration rotation speed, and a novel method, named as CSDS-AMDF, is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the desired speed curve of the drum is extracted from the STFT-based maximum harmonic value of the motor current. Secondly, the speed curve is segmented by the adaptive first-order-difference-threshold method. Finally, the segmented-Average Magnitude Difference Function (AMDF) is used to extract the rotation speed from the vibration signals of shell and outer tub according to the five segments. Taking six target speeds of a certain type of drum washing machine in the dehydration stage as the experimental object, set the sampling rates as 10kHz, 1kHz and 500Hz respectively to verify the method in this paper. The experiment shows that: The method proposed in this paper has universality for different sampling rates and robustness for 3D, and is suitable for the automatic manufacturing process of washing machines.

articleTitle: RBF Neural Network Control Based on Inverted Pendulum Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In view of the limitation that it is difficult to accurately control the nonlinear link in the inverted pendulum system control, this paper introduces the use of neural network to approximate the nonlinear link to solve the problem that the controlled object cannot be accurately controlled. This paper mainly uses neural network RBFNN (Radial Basis Function Neural Networks) and modern control theory to control the inverted pendulum system. According to the inverted pendulum model, the neural network structure control algorithm is studied, and the improved RBF neural network algorithm is used to approximate the nonlinear link of the inverted pendulum model. The control parameters of the inverted pendulum structure control algorithm are optimized. The results obtained by MATLAB simulation show that the system performance is better under neural network control, and the mapping relationship between inverted pendulum state and execution action can be established, which increases the robustness and adaptability of system control.

articleTitle: Optimized Spectral Amplitude Modulation based on Generalized Envelope for Bearing Compound Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a critical component, rolling bearings are widely adopted in rotating machinery. Therefore, bearing fault diagnosis has been a topic of intensive research in recent decades. However, current methods have focused on demodulating an optimal narrow band to detect potential bearing fault characteristic frequency (FCF). In the case of fault information being scattered over multiple frequency bands or compound damages, these methods may underdiagnose or even fail to diagnose. To tackle this issue, a optimize spectral amplitude modulation (SAM) is proposed to detect bearing compound faults. Inspired by envelope analysis, a generalized log envelope analysis is first constructed to enhance the bearing damage components masked in multiple interferences. Subsequently, a novel envelope sparsity index is developed to quantify fault information. On this basis, a weight optimization strategy is introduced to improve SAM detection accuracy, after which more obvious FCF can be identified. In this way, all fault-related information is enhanced while other components are suppressed. Finally, the advantages of the proposed method are validated by experimental data acquired from a locomotive bearing test bench. The analysis results show that the proposed method may provide an effective tool for bearing compound fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management Strategy for Hybrid Electric Agriculture Tractor
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Interest in hybrid electric agricultural tractors (HEAT) is growing as traditional agricultural tractors consume large amounts of non-renewable resources. Energy management strategy (EMS) plays an important role in improving fuel consumption. This paper studies a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based EMS for HEAT. The model of HEAT is built and rotary tillage condition is defined for better conformity with the actual situation. Simulation results show that the DRL-based EMS achieves better performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Risk Assessment Model of Coal Mine Gas Explosion Based on FTA And BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology and the intelligent development of coal mine gas explosion accident risk assessment, the fault tree analysis (FTA) method is used to analyze the causes of coal mine gas explosion accident in order to reduce the occurrence of coal mine gas explosion accident and the actual demand of coal mine safety production. The causes of coal mine gas explosion accidents are divided into four aspects: management, individual, environment and equipment. And we establish coal mine gas explosion accident index system. Then the intelligent risk assessment model of coal mine gas explosion is established based on BP neural network. Finally, the model is trained and tested. The results show that the intelligent risk assessment model of coal mine gas explosion fits well. This model has good risk assessment ability.

articleTitle: Speaker Timbre Supervision Method Based on Perceptual Loss for Voice Cloning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Current voice cloning models are only trained by approximating the generated speech to match the reference speech, without directly supervising the speaker timbre information during training. This approach is prone to interference from other factors in speech, such as semantic and prosodic information, which hinders the voice cloning model's ability to learn speaker timbre information. To address this issue, this paper proposes a speaker timbre supervision training method based on perceptual loss. Specifically, we use a speaker recognition model highly correlated with speaker information to extract speaker perceptual features and calculate speaker perceptual loss. Furthermore, we input high-level perceptual features into a speaker discriminator for adversarial training, which guides the voice cloning model to learn speaker timbre information more effectively. The experimental results show that both speaker perceptual loss and speaker discriminators based on perceptual features improve the cloned timbre similarities of the voice cloning model, and combining both yields even better results.

articleTitle: Application Research of Geological Distribution Map of Power Transmission Engineering in a Region Based on ArcGIS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The engineering survey is an important link in engineering construction. The accuracy of survey results directly affects the implementation of mechanized construction. In the feasibility study stage of transmission engineering, geotechnical engineering investigation is mostly carried out using field survey, capital collection, and geological survey, which has a certain influence on the deviation of foundation selection and earthwork estimation in the design scheme. By refining and storing geological information of 110kV and above power transmission engineering that has been put into operation in a certain region, ArcGIS software is used to draw the geological distribution map, and the reliability verification of the drawings is carried out by using some detailed surveying projects.

articleTitle: USV Formation Path Planning Based on Behavior Trees and Fast Marching Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the deployment of multiple Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) for collaborative operation, path planning is a crucial component. This paper addresses the path planning problem for USV formations operating in complex marine environments and proposes a multi-USV formation path planning method based on behavior tree formation control strategy and the Fast Marching Method (FMM). By adopting an adaptive formation library based on the FMM velocity potential field and a behavior tree formation obstacle avoidance control strategy, the path planning problem for USV formations in narrow and complex water areas is solved. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed method exhibits superior performance in complex marine environments, particularly in narrow obstacle zones.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy Based on Servo System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: For the servo system of AC motor, the classical traditional classical PID, fuzzy adaptive PID and neural network PID algorithms are tested in two cases of no disturbance and with disturbance respectively, and the optimal algorithm is selected. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the optimized controller with neural network PID algorithm has better control effect on motor position and speed control under nonlinear or disturbed conditions, and can effectively make the servo motor work in the best operation state when comparing the trajectory tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on DC Power Flow Model Considering the Integration of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traditional economic dispatching model only considers the use of system rotation reserve capacity to absorb wind power fluctuation when wind power is connected to the grid. In this paper, we also consider the influence of line constraints on the system, and give a DC power flow model considering wind power grid connection. In the test system, we set parameter <tex>$\boldsymbol{\beta}$</tex> to represent the ratio between the actual and the maximum transmission power of the line. The simulation results show that the smaller parameter <tex>$\boldsymbol{\beta}$</tex> has a positive effect on the line transmission margin, but a negative effect on the objective function.

articleTitle: Research on Wideband Testing Platform and Device for Magnetic Sensitive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Magnetic sensitive sensors are sensors that can measure changes in their own magnetic properties by converting them into electrical signals. Due to their small size and high precision, magnetic sensitive sensors are increasingly used in fields such as power systems, military, and oil exploration. However, the unknown wideband characteristics of magnetic sensitive sensors often lead to difficulties in accurately measuring high-frequency signals. To address the wideband testing problem of magnetic sensitive sensors, this paper takes TMR sensors as an example and studies wideband calibration methods, builds a wideband testing platform, and conducts wideband testing experiments. The results prove that the wideband testing platform can effectively evaluate the wideband characteristics of magnetic sensitive sensors.

articleTitle: Ultrashort Baseline Underwater Acoustic Positioning System Based on Timestamp
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The existing conventional ultra-short baseline system uses half of the propagation time delay as the processing parameter for positioning solution, but the hydroacoustic transponder will move a certain distance when interconnecting with the underwater operation device and the hull where the ultra-short baseline base array is located, which will have some influence on the positioning of the ultra-short baseline system. In order to reduce the positioning error of the ultrashort baseline system, this paper adopts broadband spread spectrum signals and modulated signals carrying time stamps for hydroacoustic positioning, and adopts the method of obtaining time stamp information and combining with atomic clock chips to obtain time information when receiving and transmitting acoustic signals to estimate the slant distance between the underwater operating unit and the water platform and estimate the one-sided propagation time delay, so that the water platform can obtain more accurate data, which has been It is proved that this method can reduce the hydroacoustic positioning error.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Control Technology of Passive Hydrogen Maser
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The passive hydrogen maser is one of the widely used atomic frequency standards with outstanding performance, which utilizes a hyper-fine transition between two ground state levels of hydrogen atoms as a frequency discriminator. In the past, the space passive hydrogen maser is developed, which outputs the standard signal for satellite navigation and positioning systems. Its structures are suitable for space-borne but not convenient for user operation. For the passive hydrogen maser for surface use, the automatic control technology is significant. With the FPGA technique to design the servo loop and the temperature control loop, the passive hydrogen maser performance is improved and the debugging becomes easy. The long-duration frequency stability performance is better than 5*10<sup>−13</sup>at one second and 4*10<sup>−15</sup> at one day, which reached the international advanced level. To facilitate the operation personnel monitoring, the working status data of the passive hydrogen maser is displayed and critical parameters can be set by the liquid crystal display touchscreen through the display and control system. In addition, real-time control between the computer and the passive hydrogen maser is realized through network interface communication. Thus, the data and parameters can be monitored and controlled through IPC.

articleTitle: Research on prediction of wax deposition rate based on improved Support Vector Machines model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Accurately predict the wax deposition rate can ensure the safe operation of waxy crude oil pipelines. This paper proposes a combination model for wax deposition rate prediction based on Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO), Improved Simulated Annealing Particle Swarm Optimization (ISAPSO) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Taking 200 sets of operating data in Jinghui Pipeline as the research samples, which are simplified by using LASSO algorithm to extract key factors affected the wax deposition rate. Adopting ISAPSO which is obtained by optimizing the particle initialization, inertia weight and learning factors of SAPSO algorithm to optimize the input weight and the spread of SVM. Using MATLAB software to build the prediction model and make the prediction, and the prediction results of LASSO-ISAPSO-SVM model are compared with those of Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) model and LASSO-ISAPSO-RBF model. The results are as follows: the key factors affected the wax deposition rate are extracted from 8 to 5 by LASSO; ISAPSO converges 54 iterations earlier than SAPSO and has higher optimization accuracy; The predicted value of LASSO-ISAPSO-SVM model is closer to the actual value compared with BPNN model and LASSO-ISAPSO-RBF model, with the average absolute error within <tex>$+0.25$</tex> and the average relative error is less than 8.1%.

Author Keywords: Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO)
Improved Simulated Annealing Particle Swarm Optimization (ISAPSO)

articleTitle: Feature Point Identification of Hydropower Plant Based on Improved ORB Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traditional ORB algorithm has some problems such as poor feature point recognition, difficult to eliminate mismatching and scale invariance. This paper presents an improved ORB algorithm to identify and match feature points of hydropower plant. First of all, FAST algorithm uses rBRIEF descriptor to describe the detected feature points in the images of hydropower station equipment; Secondly, the feature points extracted by ORB were constructed by Hessian matrix to extract the feature points of hydropower equipment images. Finally, the direction consistency of feature points is used to eliminate the feature points that are not within the threshold range by cosine similarity invariance. The algorithm improves the accuracy of feature point matching, eliminates mismatching feature points and has the advantages of fast matching speed.

articleTitle: A Method for Detecting Shallow Cavities in Roadbeds Based on Deep Learning and Ground Penetrating Radar Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the course of road use, cavity disease in the roadbed area is often a direct threat to the structural stability of the road. This is because unfavourable geological conditions in various roadbed areas often end up forming cavities, making it an important issue to investigate how to intelligently detect cavities in roadbeds. To this end, an experimental road has been built specifically for radar detection and a large number of cavity models of varying sizes and depths have been embedded in the roadbed area of the experimental road. Using a known real model and a software simulation model built partly by the time-domain finite difference method as the object of study, a deep learning framework was used to construct a mapping relationship between ground-penetrating radar images and subsurface dielectric constant maps, identifying the limitations of the current study, which has served to advance the application of deep learning in the analysis of road ground-penetrating radar images.

articleTitle: Research on Investigation of Hidden Dangers and Diseases in Areas Influenced by Subway Traversing Existing Railway Line Based on Method of Composite Geophysical Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the continuous construction of subways in major cities in China, subways often need to traverse the existing railway lines above. After the subway traversed the railway above it, there will be an urgent engineering problem to be solved, which is to evaluate the soil under the existing railway. By comprehensively using the method of “microtremor exploration method plus ground penetrating radar method” to detect the subway traversing the railway section on the ground, and the ground penetrating radar method to detect the stratum above the subway tunnel, the paper has investigated whether there are underground diseases such as void or loosely infilled void in the stratum between the subway tunnel and the railway line, providing the basis for the subsequent reinforcement for underground diseases.

articleTitle: High-Precision Calibration Method of Inclinometer for Coal Mine Based on Improved Ellipsoid Fitting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The inclinometer for coal mine is limited by the downhole drilling conditions, it usually composed of magnetic sensor and MEMS accelerometer, and the drilling trajectory parameters can be solved through the principle of inclination principle. However, in fact, due to the existence of various errors, before the inclinometer is used, it must be calibrated to correct the error. The traditional method is ellipsoid fitting, which can quickly meet the error compensation of three-dimensional space, but there is a problem of algorithm instability caused by constraint matrix singularity during solution, and the compensation effect is limited. In this paper, an improved ellipsoid fitting calibration algorithm is proposed to solve the above problems and to Secondary compensate for the remaining angle error. The result is that the root mean square error of azimuth angle is reduced from 9.72° to 0.86°, which shows that the improved ellipsoid fitting method has significantly improved the measurement accuracy of the inclinometer.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on IGJO Optimized SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the issue of low accuracy in transformer fault diagnosis, an improved Golden Jackal Algorithm (GJO) optimized Support Vector Machine (SVM) method for power transformer fault diagnosis is proposed. Using kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) to screen data features and obtain features with a high impact rate; Reverse learning and adaptive t-distribution perturbation are introduced to improve the original golden jackal optimization algorithm, and improve the global optimization ability of golden jackal algorithm; Use the improved algorithm to optimize the main parameters of SVM, establish an IGJO optimized SVM power transformer fault diagnosis model, and input the KPCA processed data into the established model for training and testing. The results showed that the accuracy of the IGJO-SVM model reached 91.43%, and compared with the GJO-SVM and PSO-SVM models, the accuracy increased by 4.29% and 1.43%, respectively, which can effectively improve the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Fractured Formation Response of LWD Resistivity Imaging Tool in Horizontal Wells
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The resistivity of fractured formation in horizontal wells has non-homogeneity, logging response mechanism is complex, the Logging While Drilling (LWD) resistivity imaging tool can visually identify fractures and calculated its parameters quantitatively. In this paper, using the method of transition boundary conditions (TBC), the fracture is equivalent to the plane. Combined with the finite element method (FEM), the modeling of LWD resistivity imaging tool is built, which reduced the amount of grid. The excitation source of toroid is equivalent to the surface magnetic current source. Compared with the analytic solution of electrical dipole, the equivalent method is proved correctly. Firstly, we analyzed the responses of fracture with different apertures. Secondly, we studied the current of the button electrode under different standoffs. Finally, we simulated fracture formation response under different mud invasion depth. The results showed that fracture apertures had a good linear relationship with maximum current contrast. The current peak value of button electrode increased with the standoffs. The depth of mud invasion had an exponential relationship with the abnormal current area. The results can provide a theoretical basis for the fracture identification and interpretation of LWD resistivity imaging tool in horizontal wells.

articleTitle: Fusion Detection Algorithm of Maritime Radar and Electro-Optical Pod for Complex Sea Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to improve the perceptual capability of Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) in complex sea conditions, a fusion detection algorithm has been developed that combines maritime radar and electro-optical (EO) pod. This algorithm integrates the positional state of the USV, class information of the maritime target obtained through a vision-based target detection algorithm, and processed maritime radar information. By using Gaussian and morphological filtering, the fusion of position state information from the USV, EO pod data, and maritime radar data is achieved. This effectively mitigates the negative impact of environmental factors, such as waves and water mist, on target detection. A cooperative sensing process between the maritime radar and EO pod is proposed to fuse the data obtained from both sources, resulting in accurate comprehensive target information. Experimental results show that the fusion algorithm achieves an average accuracy of 80.24% and a detection rate of 74.7%, enabling precise detection of maritime targets, including their distance, speed, and category. This enhanced perceptual capability is essential for USVs operating in complex maritime environments, enabling better decision-making and navigation performance.

articleTitle: A Target Pose Processing Method based on Multi-Line Vector Object-Image Mapping Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the practical application of middle& long-distance measurement, due to view occlusion, target movement or other reasons, it is difficult to extract stable feature points with the same feature points. In this paper, pure straight line vector is adopted to solve the pose processing problem. Based on th 3D-2D correspondence between linear vector object space and image space, this paper establishes the universal method of pose processing for axisymmetric rotating body targets and non-axisymmetric rotating body targets for the first time, and solves the ambiguity of monocular station pose processing; this method only uses a small amount of key line vector information, and has the advantages of no homonymous features, effective anti occlusion and strong processing flexibility in feature extraction; in terms of processing, the accuracy and stability are improved because the linear vector is based on pure direction solution, which excludes the usual coupling factors of position and pose.

articleTitle: Study on Adaptability of Automatic Generation Algorithm of Primary Electric Wiring Diagram for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to obtain the optimal wiring layout of substation, the general model of power system is introduced. Based on this, the force-directed algorithm, genetic algorithm, graph community clustering algorithm and depth first search algorithm are analyzed. The above four algorithms are used to automatically generate the primary electric wiring diagram of a 35 kV distribution network, and the calculation time and other performance are compared. The results show that the calculation time of the force-directed algorithm is shorter, but there are too many crossing points. The genetic algorithm requires too many iterations and has poor real-time performance. However, as long as the parameters are selected properly and the number of iterations is enough, the algorithm will tend to the optimal solution. Both the graph community clustering algorithm and depth first search algorithm have shorter calculation time, but the former is not easy to obtain the optimal solution, while the latter can maintain the speed and obtain the optimal solution at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Critical Boundary Identification Algorithm in Interlocking Overload Trip Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, grid chain failure has become a hot issue, the chain trip and large area power outage are often caused by some key lines in the system. In order to quickly identify the key lines in power system and effectively prevent the occurrence of interlocking trip faults, this paper introduces the algorithm of interlocking overload trip recognition based on the critical boundary model, and realizes the effective recognition of the key branches by calculating the safety margin. At the same time, the IEEE 39 node system is taken as an example for verification analysis. This method has theoretical reference value for preventing interlocking overload tripping and maintaining safe and stable operation of power system.

articleTitle: Study on Monte Carlo Method for Measurement Uncertainty Evaluation of Automatic Twin-wheel Side Force Coefficient Testing System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper uses Monte Carlo method and adaptive Monte Carlo method to evaluate the measurement uncertainty of automatic Twin-wheel side force coefficient testing system. By comparing the measurement uncertainty evaluation results with the GUM method, we further analyze the influencing factors of the measurement uncertainty of automatic Twin-wheel side force coefficient testing system. At the same time, the comparison process can provide theoretical basis for the scope and effect of the two uncertainty evaluation methods in engineering applications.

Author Keywords: automatic Twin-wheel side force coefficient testing system

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Speed Control System for the In-service Gas Pipeline Detectors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The complex working conditions, high operating pressure and fast fluid velocity of large-diameter long-distance natural gas pipelines pose great challenges to the methods and safety of pipeline detection, and the precise velocity control of the pipeline detector under high fluid velocity has become a core technical issue. This paper introduces the intelligent velocity control system design of the pipeline detector. The system controls the drainage area in real time by driving servo motors, collects the running speed of the pipeline detector with mileage sensors, and adjusts the running speed by changing the size of the drainage area. The control system can reduced operating speed to less than 1/2 of the fluid velocity. The stability, reliability and safety of the system has been tested and verified in several project.

articleTitle: Research on Reflection Model for Portable Solar Absorption Ratio Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Based on the integrating sphere method, the algorithm of reflection model for portable measurement system is proposed to reduce the influence of non-ideal integrating reflection model on solar absorption ratio measurement. Integrating sphere reflection model is generated through analysis and experiment of incident light shaping, and the systematic error of non-ideal integrating reflection model is eliminated by correction factor of measurement system. The feasibility and reality of the model is validated by comparison between the result of portable measurement system and the result of the result measured by spectrophotometer, and the measurement accuracy of the portal solar absorption ratio measurement system.

articleTitle: A MIM Waveguide Refractive-Index Construction According To SPPs and Fano Resonance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Here in, a micro and nano sensing structure constructed by a metal-insulator-metal (MIM) waveguide coupled with a ring cavity built-in two rectangles (RCBITR) is engineered on the basis of Surface Plasmon Excitation Element and Fano resonance. The transmission capability of the plasma waveguide coupled system are rationally examined by means of the finite element method sub. Also, the specific effects of different structural arguments on the sensitivity and FOM values of the system are evaluated. Simulations show that a pointed unsymmetric Fano resonance appears in the structure, and that separate attunements of the Fano resonance can be accomplished by varying changing the size of the two rectangular cavities and the filling medium. The final sensitivity and FOM values of the designed structure were calculated to be 2660 and 54.28 respectively. The designed structure greatly breaks the limitation of the traditional cavity, which is of considerable help to enhance the integration of the surface-based equipartition excitation sensor.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Planning Method Applied to Intersecting Line Smooth Cutting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The cutting quality of intersecting lines can be affected by cutting model and cutting process. To improve that, this paper builds a round pipe-intersecting cutting model connected by branch pipe internally without groove according to the principle of intersecting, and it uses the smooth transition algorithm for the cutting start point to avoid the generation of cutting gaps. Finally, the model's trajectory planning algorithm is verified through robot simulation experiments. The result shows that this method can improve the cutting quality by the established model and has good significance in reality.

articleTitle: Behavior Simulation of Disturbed UAV Based on NetLogo
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The rapid development of many electronic devices has made the electromagnetic space environment more and more complex. UAV s face severe challenges in flying in the complex electromagnetic space environment. Studing the electronic jamming at the soft-kill level of UAVs, establishes the UAV system model through the NetLogo multi-agent simulation software, builds the UAV flight environment, and uses MATLAB to establish a jammer model to carry out navigation signals and data links for UAVs interference. Use the NetLogo extension function to call MATLAB for interference simulation to simulate the behavior of the UAV under interference conditions. The simulated behavior of UAVs in the electromagnetic interference environment will provide important guidance for the development of UAVs and the development of anti-UAV systems.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Control Technology for Dryness and Volue of Flow of Steam Injection Boilers in Heavy Oil Thermal Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The intelligent design of non-contact conductivity sensing technology for measuring steam dryness and the installation of electromagnetic flow meters for flow monitoring technology in front of the inlet of the plunger pump is carried out to achieve continuous measurement of steam dryness and flow rate injected into the reservoir during thermal recovery development of heavy oil reservoirs; The measurement results of this design are intuitive and visible, allowing for parameter comparison; By setting safety thresholds, the safe operation of the boiler can be ensured; The principle and manufacturing process of this intelligent instrument are simple, and the maintenance cost is low; At the same time, due to its ability to perform precision debugging at any time, the instrument has high measurement accuracy and meets the needs of geological workers for continuous monitoring of injected steam dryness and flow rate in heavy oil reservoirs. This technology has been tested onsite in a steam drive well group of a certain reservoir in Shuyi District, Liaohe Oilfield, and has achieved good application results. It has important guiding significance for strengthening the monitoring of steam drive reservoirs and improving the development level of heavy oil thermal recovery.

articleTitle: UWB-IMU Pose Estimation for Roadheader Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Abastact- The roadheader is an important equipment for mining coal underground, and precise positioning is the key technology for the intelligentization of the roadheader. This paper proposes a machine learning-based ultra wide band-inertial measurement unit (UWB-IMU) positioning method for the roadheader. By fitting the nonlinear transformation relationship between the 16 ranging values of UWB, 2 attitude angles of IMU, and the position and yaw angle of the roadheader using machine learning, the three-axis position average absolute error of the method is less than 0.10m, and the average absolute error of the three-axis attitude angle is less than 1°, which meets the positioning requirements of the roadway roadheader according to experimental verification.

articleTitle: Stabilization of a 4D Quadratic Polynomial Chaotic System with No Constant Term via a T-S Fuzzy Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A problem on stabilization of a 4D quadratic polynomial chaotic system with five linear terms and six nonlinear terms is investigated in this paper. The chaotic system with complex structures has no any constant term. The origin is one of the equilibria. Dynamical behaviors including offset boosting are analyzed. The 4D polynomial chaotic system can be converted into a T-S fuzzy model with two simple rules. A local T-S fuzzy model is constructed successfully. Based on a linear matrix inequality approach, a local T-S fuzzy controller is designed effectively to stabilize the 4D polynomial chaotic system within a finite time.

articleTitle: Research on AC Servo Control System of Medical Centrifuge Based on Fuzzy Adaptive Fractional PID
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of slow response and poor dynamic performance of AC servo control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor used in medical centrifuge, a fuzzy adaptive fractional PID controller is proposed in this paper. The fractional PID control algorithm has higher control precision than the traditional digital PID control algorithm. The fuzzy control does not depend on the mathematical model of the controlled object, and can realize the online tuning and optimization of the controller parameters. The simulation results show that the fuzzy adaptive fractional PID AC servo control system has the advantages of fast response speed, small overshoot and strong anti-interference ability, which effectively improves the dynamic and static performance of medical centrifuge and has good robustness.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Method Based on Cross-Attention and Convolution for Postoperative Infection Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Postoperative infection diagnosis is a common and serious complication that generally poses a high diagnostic challenge. This study focuses on PJI, a type of postoperative infection. X-ray examination is an imaging examination for suspected PJI patients that can evaluate joint prostheses and adjacent tissues, and detect the cause of pain. Laboratory examination data has high sensitivity and specificity and has significant potential in PJI diagnosis. In this study, we proposed a self-supervised masked autoencoder pre-training strategy and a multimodal fusion diagnostic network MED-NVC, which effectively implements the interaction between two modal features through the feature fusion network of CrossAttention. We tested our proposed method on our collected PJI dataset and evaluated its performance and feasibility through comparison and ablation experiments. The results showed that our method achieved an ACC of 94.71% and an AUC of 98.22%, which is better than the latest method and also reduces the number of parameters. Our proposed method has the potential to provide clinicians with a powerful tool for enhancing accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: DA-YOLOv7: Velocity Spectrum Pickup Based on Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The automatic picking of velocity spectrum based on object detection has proven its effectiveness, but these models are limited to the current training work area and cannot get effective inference in other work areas. To improve model generalization and achieve the automatic picking of velocity spectrum in other work areas without enough velocity spectrums and labels, our paper designs a Domain Adaptation velocity spectrum picking model DA-YOLOv7, and optimizes the network to improve the picking accuracy. At the same time, in order to address the domain gap, training pseudo images are generated through image-to-image translation and used as inputs for model training. Finally, post process the results through the constrained KNN anomaly detection method, screen and eliminate the outlier, so that the results are closer to the manual picking up. By comparing with the SOTA domain adaptation networks, it is proved that DA- YOLOv7 is superior to the existing model in precision and visualization.

articleTitle: Research on the Attenuation Characteristics of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Drilling Fluid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ultrasonic detection method is to obtain the solid phase concentration by measuring the acoustic attenuation in the two-phase flow and comparing it with the predicted results in the mathematical model through inverse calculation. To address the problem that the ultrasonic detection method is not highly accurate for the solid phase concentration of drilling fluid and cannot accurately reflect the attenuation characteristics of ultrasonic waves propagating in drilling fluid, based on the theoretical analysis of the ultrasonic wave attenuation characteristics, MATLAB software was used to The relationship between ultrasonic attenuation coefficient and ultrasonic frequency, drilling fluid particle size, density and frequency was obtained: at a certain ultrasonic frequency, the scattering attenuation increases as the drilling fluid particle size increases; when ultrasonic frequency and drilling fluid particle size are both fixed values, the viscous attenuation coefficient increases with the increase of drilling fluid density; when ultrasonic frequency and drilling fluid particle size are both fixed values, the viscous attenuation coefficient increases with the increase of drilling fluid density; When both ultrasonic frequency and drilling fluid density are fixed values, the larger the particle size of drilling fluid, the smaller the viscous attenuation coefficient. The results of this study provide a theoretical basis for further application of ultrasonic waves in solid phase concentration measurement of drilling fluids.

articleTitle: Research on Underground Mine Helmet Detection Based on AOD-Net and Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Since the working environment in underground mines has more fog and dust and lower illumination, so there are problems such as blurred target images and low target detection accuracy; this paper investigates a method to detect whether miners are wearing helmets based on deep learning theory. This paper uses AOD-Net and the improved YOLOv5 algorithm to train on a homemade underground helmet dataset. AOD-Net is a lightweight dehazing neural network. The training results show that combining these two algorithms has better prediction results. The volume of the improved YOLOv5 algorithm is reduced by 43.85%, the mAP can still be maintained at 0.91, and its detection speed is close to YOLOv5s, which can detect 50 images per second, so the improved YOLOv5 can fully meet the requirements of real-time detection. After AOD-Net dehazing the target images and then using the improved YOLOv5 algorithm to detect the target, this method can improve the accuracy by about 3%.

articleTitle: A Drilling Pressure and Torque Characterization Method of Measuring Short Joint While Drilling in Small Boreholes
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
