abstract: For drilling accidents that are likely to occur during the drilling of small boreholes, an analytical method for measuring short joint in small borehole drilling pressure and torque with drilling is proposed. First, a parametric finite element simulation model based on ANSYS for small borehole measurement short joint is established. Subsequently, the structural static analysis module of ANSYS Workbench software is used to simulate the drilling pressure and torque on the drill collar. Finally, for measuring the strain distribution of short joint under both drilling pressure and torque and measuring the stress of short joint in the well are summarized. The simulation experiments confirme that the drilling pressure during the drilling of small boreholes has an effect on the torque measurement results, the torque has almost no effect on the drilling pressure measurement results, and the mechanical structure strength of the tool can meet the downhole construction requirements. Characterization of short joint for drilling pressure and torque measurement with drilling in small boreholes improves the reliability and safety of drilling pressure and torque measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Water Cooling and Heat Dissipation Characteristics of Power Module of Electric Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to reduce the temperature rise of the power module of the electric propulsion system, the water-cooled radiator of the power module of the electric aircraft motor controller is designed. The influence of the inlet fluid flow rate of the water-cooled radiator on the heat dissipation performance of the radiator was analyzed, the power loss of the electric aircraft under the two working conditions of take-off climb and cruise control was calculated, and the heat dissipation performance of the water-cooled radiator in this paper was simulated by finite element software. The results show that the water-cooled plate structure mentioned in this paper can keep the maximum temperature of the IGBT module below 85°C, which effectively proves the rationality of the heat dissipation structure of this water-cooled radiator.

articleTitle: Research on the Fall Detection Method Based on Millimeter-Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Fall is the leading cause of injury and even death in the elderly. In order to reduce the disability rate and mortality rate of the elderly after falling, a fall detection method based on millimeter wave radar is proposed. In this paper, wavelet transform is used to analyze the time-frequency of millimeter wave radar signal, and LOWESS (Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing) is used to process the echo data, and fall is detected by analyzing the change characteristics of the echo signal. The experimental results show that the detection method greatly improves the efficiency of fall detection.

articleTitle: Study on Seepage Velocity Detection Technology of Tailings Pond
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Tailings reservoir seepage refers to the flow of fluid in the pore medium of tailings sand soil. When the rainfall is too large or there is a large water source near the tailings pond, it is easy to form seepage, so that the tailings pond has the risk of dam break. In order to detect the real flow velocity of seepage in tailings reservoir and not change the flow state during seepage detection, a seepage detector based on the principle of thermal temperature difference is designed in this paper. The temperature difference signals collected by the upstream and downstream temperature sensors are converted into electrical signals by the acquisition circuit and sent to MCU for data processing. Through corresponding numerical conversion, the current seepage velocity can be observed on Ali Cloud and the upper computer. The detector device is small in size, easy to install, no need to take over more external equipment, can be buried in the tailings pond for long-term real-time monitoring, and will not cause pollution to the surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of High-Precision Infrared Temperature Measurement Device Based on Butterworth Filter for Laser Soft Soldering
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Real-time measurement of solder joint temperature and precise adjustment of the output power of the semiconductor laser are crucial to ensure high-quality laser soldering. To prevent solder joint scorching, virtual soldering, and false soldering caused by measurement errors or slow measurement speed, a high-precision infrared temperature measurement device was designed in this study. The principle of infrared temperature measurement is introduced first, followed by a detailed explanation of the main signal processing method used Butterworth filter and the photoelectric conversion circuit design method. Finally, experimental analysis is presented to verify the performance of the device. The results demonstrate that the infrared temperature measurement device designed in this study is suitable for non-contact measurement of laser soft soldering solder joint temperature with an error range of only 2%. This indicates the effectiveness of the device in enabling real-time temperature measurement and precise power control during laser soldering processes.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Range and Tilt Angle Detection Based on Air-coupled Leaky Lamb Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: External sensing based on plate-like structures has attracted much attention in many applications as it can obtain important features of nearby objects in some complex and difficult-to-measure scenarios. In this paper, a simulation study proposes a non-contact detection method for the range and tilt angle of the target objects using air-coupled leaky Lamb waves. A pitch-catch configuration is considered common use and comprises the transmitting and receiving transducers, both positioned on the same side of a thin plate, and the detected object located on the opposite side. A Lamb wave was first excited in the plate, and its leakage in the air was used to detect the object. To investigate the wave field affected by the object, a multiphysics model was established. This model facilitated the visualization of the leaky waves reflected by the object and the new excited Lamb wave in the plate. The signals from this Lamb wave were captured by the receiver, and their changes in waveform and time shift due to the different spatial features of the detected objects were also well illustrated. This entirely non-contact approach to range and tilt angle detection of external objects could be applied in many cutting-edge fields, such as industrial multidimensional awareness and human-computer interaction with smart equipment.

articleTitle: Keyword Search of Incomplete Graph Based on Kernel Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the keyword search problem, the incomplete graph situation is a unavoidable role. Aiming at the incomplete graph situation that is not fully considered in the existing methods, a keyword search method for incomplete graphs based on kernel principal component analysis is proposed. First, the dimension reduction of the feature vector is carried out through the kernel function; then, the keyword feature vector is extracted through KPCA; finally, all the feature vectors are sorted to obtain the final keyword search result. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves high accuracy in keyword search with less running time; compared with other algorithms, the proposed method has better performance in terms of recall and precision.

articleTitle: All-organic Energy Storage Dielectrics with Synergistic Optimization of Polarization and Breakdown Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Polymer dielectric is an important component of electrostatic capacitors, and the studies of polymer dielectrics with excellent energy storage characteristics are of great significance to the development of electrostatic capacitors. Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) has attracted widespread attention because of its high dielectric constant. However, PVDF's poor insulation properties put serious constraints on its excellent energy storage density. In this research, a double-layer energy storage dielectric was prepared by introducing polyetherimide (PEl) with excellent insulation characteristics, using PVDF to provide a high polarization strength, and employing PEl to inhibit the growth of the conductive path. Through such preparations, the composite dielectric (PVDF/PEI) was endowed with both excellent polarization and high voltage resistance characteristics and obtained an all-organic composite dielectric with outstanding energy storage characteristics. The obtained PVDF/PEI composite dielectric can withstand an electric field strength of 500 MV/m, which is 2 times that of PVDF and provides an energy storage density that is 1.89 times that of PVDF. In summary, the energy storage density of PVDF has been significantly increased by the introduction of PEI.

articleTitle: An Improved Sand Cat Swarm Optimization and Its Application in Aluminum Melting Process
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To optimize the furnace temperature prediction model for an aluminum melting process, an improved sand cat swarm optimization (PSCSO) is proposed. Firstly, a chaotic convergence factor is introduced in the process of each iteration, which changes the strategy selection mechanism of the algorithm and improves its speed and accuracy. Secondly, a population redistribution strategy is designed at the completion of each iteration to increase the algorithm's space utilization of the solution space. Finally, an optimal value jumping strategy is proposed to avoid the algorithm from falling into local optimum at the later stage of iteration. The proposed method is validated on some common benchmark functions and an example of its application used in aluminum smelting. The results show that PSCSO has better performance compared with other optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: The Method of Tile Surface Defect Detection Based on Improved Deeplabv3+
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To deal with the problems of slow model running speed and inaccurate edge feature extraction in the current ceramic tile surface defect detection, this paper proposed an improved ceramic tile surface defect detection method. This method effectively improves the running speed of the algorithm by using the lightweight backbone network MobileNetv2 instead of the backbone network Xception of Deeplabv3+. At the same time, the attention mechanism module CBAM is introduced, which can pay more attention to edge defect information and small-scale defect information, and suppress useless background information and noise information, thus significantly improving the segmentation accuracy. The experimental results show that the MIoU value of the improved algorithm reaches 89.34 %, the MPA value reaches 98.32 %, the FPS is 51.47, and the Accuracy value is 98.56 %. Compared with the model before the improvement, it is increased by 3.87 %, 1.47 %, 7.61 and 1.32 %, respectively, and the segmentation accuracy and detection speed are significantly improved. Therefore, the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively complete the ceramic tile surface defect detection task.

articleTitle: Research on Imaging Algorithm of Industrial Pipeline Detection Based on List-Mode Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to realize the y-photon nondestructive detection of industrial confined pipelines, it is necessary to construct large axial ring y-photon detectors, but with the increase of the axial length of the detectors, the acquisition of response lines will be truncated and missing, resulting in the degradation of the detection imaging quality in large axial space. In this paper, we propose a list-mode data-based imaging algorithm for industrial confined pipe detection, which makes full use of the list-mode to conform to the position and time information in the event and to reasonably assign the weights of the system matrix in the image reconstruction. When calculating the weight contribution of the pixels passing through a response line to that response line, only the pixels within the uncertainty range need to be calculated without the pixels corresponding to the complete response line, and the system matrix containing time-of-flight (TOF) information is obtained, thus effectively suppressing the noise caused by truncated and missing large axial spatial data. In addition, the parallel feature of CUDA is also used to divide the system matrix calculation process into small blocks that are independent of each other to achieve accelerated optimization of the algorithm. Finally, two industrial models are used for simulation experiments, and the experimental results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the resolution and spatial contrast of large axial spatial reconstruction images in industrial confined pipeline inspection, and can meet the demand of y-photon nondestructive inspection of industrial confined pipelines.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Cylinder CPTU Probe
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Cone tip resistance is an essential parameter of static penetration technology, which plays a vital role in soil classification and layer division. The existing CPT technology was compared and analyzed, and it was found that the detection sensitivity of the soft soil layer in the soft and hard soil layer mixed with seabed silt, clay, and sand was not high. Therefore, a multi-cylinder CPTU probe was developed. The cone tip resistance is measured through the “double-cylinder” structure of the inner cylinder and the middle cylinder, which has the advantages of high sensitivity and extensive range and can simultaneously measure the soft soil area in the shallow sea and the hard soil area in the deep sea. The designed probe is tested on the simulation platform, and the measurement circuit is used to measure the full-bridge circuit composed of the stress sensor. The measured data is processed by curve fitting, and system identification. The experimental results show that the inner cylinder has the highest sensitivity and is suitable for measuring soft soil layers, and the measurement range of soft soil changes with the height difference of the inner cylinder; the middle cylinder has an extensive range and is suitable for measuring hard soil layers. The designed probe enters a steady state within 60ms, and the overshoot is less than 1%, so it has the advantages of high sensitivity, extensive range, fast response, and slight overshoot. It meets the requirements of relevant survey work. At the same time, the multi-cylinder structure provides a research idea for solving the problem that the sensor can not have both range and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Influence of Mountain Topography on Receiver Layout in Transient Electromagnetic Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the great difficulty that mountainous terrain poses for resource exploration, the undulating terrain outside the emission source has an impact on the electromagnetic response. Further research is still needed for relevant issues. In this paper, a three-dimensional terrain-constrained airborne transient electromagnetic forward simulation is implemented based on the finite element method. Mountainous terrain is arranged outside the emission source, and the distance between the mountainous terrain and the emission source is quantitatively analyzed, and the error distribution caused by terrain at different receiving points is given. The impact of mountainous terrain on the electromagnetic response characteristics is analyzed, which provides a theoretical basis for the layout of receiving sources in airborne transient electromagnetic exploration.

articleTitle: Design of Shock Measurement System While Drilling
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: During drilling, downhole shock can cause drilling tool fatigue or bit damage. To study the influence of shock on downhole tools, a downhole shock measurement system was designed to quantify the risk of downhole shock. Firstly, the system's requirements were analyzed, and technical indicators were determined. Secondly, the measurement system was built with TMS320F28335 as the central controller, and the software and hardware design were completed. Finally, the practicality and stability of the system were verified. The results indicate that the impact measurement system while drilling can effectively monitor downhole impacts and determine high-risk situations based on impact strength, meeting design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Wheel Defect Recognition Based on VGG Network and Electromagnetic Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, based on the principle of ultrasonic phased array detection, a two-dimensional simulation model of 16-channel electromagnetic ultrasonic phased array detection for wheels was established by COMSOL Multiphysics finite element simulation software. By using this model, the detection process of cracks at different angles of train wheels is simulated, and the echo signals received by 16 array elements are collected. These echo signals are preprocessed and used for the training of convolutional neural network, and the classification model of the electromagnetic ultrasonic phased array for the detection of train wheel defects is obtained. Through simulation data verification, the model can identify the inside of the wheel with or without defects with an accuracy of 80%. The method can quickly form the echo data into the image set for deep learning. The training speed and recognition speed are much higher than that of training and recognition with 16 element waveforms, which improves the efficiency of defect recognition.

articleTitle: User Behavior Analysis of Substation Area Based on Improved K-Means Quadratic Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiency of low efficiency and accuracy of traditional or single clustering algorithm in user behavior analysis of substation area, an improved dynamic weighted density clustering algorithm combined with k-means (DWDC-k-means) quadratic clustering algorithm was proposed. Firstly, based on the user aggregation degree and the sum of the squared errors (SSE), construct the initial return indicator of clustering and select the optimal clustering k value. Then, dynamic weighted density clustering algorithm is used to select initial clustering centers. Finally, k-means clustering based on the fusion similarity feature of weighted Euclidean distance and differential Pearson correlation distance in the second clustering stage. The algorithm is verified by the measured data set of the smart grid substation area, and the results show that the DWDC-k-means quadratic algorithm proposed in this paper can extract the typical user patterns more accurately than the contrast algorithm, and has a significant improvement in the given clustering performance index.

articleTitle: A Training Assistance System Based on MEMS Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The rapid development of IoT technology has led to an increasing number of people using MEMS-based inertial sensors for motion recognition. To address issues such as incorrect training techniques causing injuries and low training efficiency, this study focuses on physical training-related motion techniques. Aiming to accurately grasp the training effects of each trainee, this study uses MEMS-based inertial sensors to collect human motion information, and transmits real-time motion data through WIFI. A combination network model based on 1D CNN-LSTM is designed to achieve human action recognition. The 1D CNN (one-dimensional convolutional neural network) is used to obtain low-dimensional features with advantages of lightweight and fast computation, while LSTM (long short-term memory network) is utilized for learning to effectively process time-series signals output by posture sensors. After action recognition, different data are selected to judge whether actions are standardized or not, and feedback is provided accordingly. A training-assist system based on MEMS inertial sensors is designed to efficiently improve physical training effects and levels.

articleTitle: Research on Image Processing Method of Laser Ultrasonic Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the industrial production, it is very important to detect the defects of the workpiece. The laser ultrasonic detection technology has become the most widely used detection technology because of its small damage, high sensitivity and accurate detection position. However, in the process of defect detection, the external noise and the instrument itself will affect the result of defect detection. In order to obtain more accurate defect information, the defect image is processed, and image denoising, image enhancement and defect segmentation are carried out respectively. Wavelet transform was used for image denoising, and denoising methods suitable for laser ultrasonic defect images were studied from two perspectives: wavelet method and selection of wavelet basis. Histogram equalization is used for image enhancement to improve image contrast. Select the Canny edge extraction operator to extract defect information from the image. An image processing system for laser ultrasonic defect detection images was established in three parts: image denoising, image enhancement, and feature extraction.

articleTitle: Multi-Classification of Ultra-Wideband Non-Line-of-Sight Ranging Signals using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) is an emerging technology with numerous applications, such as indoor positioning, object tracking, and wireless sensor networks. However, non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenarios can cause significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a deep learning model specifically designed for accurately identifying various types NLOS UWB ranging signals for better error mitigation. We extract 13 feature parameters from low-cost UWB sensors to characterize channel quality. Our proposed deep learning model consists of a convolutional neural network module, a long short-term memory module, and a fully connected module for extracting spatial and time-domain features. Through field experiments, we demonstrate that our model achieves high accuracy and F1 score of 0.98 and 0.97, respectively, indicating its potential for accurately identifying different types of NLOS cases in UWB ranging.

articleTitle: Weak Maneuvering Target Detection Using Cost-Reference Particle Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a novel cost-reference particle filter bank (CRPFB) based method is proposed for detecting a low signal to noise ratio (SNR) nonlinear frequency modulated signal. The proposed method has two stages. First, the designed CRPFB is used for state estimation of a possible target. Second, a test metric (i.e., generalized likelihood ratio) based on the state estimation of the first stage is compared with an analyzable threshold for determining the presence of a target. In first stage, the CRPFB consists of many parallel cost-reference particle filters (CRPFs). The output of the CRPF with the minimum cumulated cost is considered as the estimation results of the CRPFB. In second stage, the threshold can be analytically obtained from several noisy-only measurements by using generalized extreme value distribution. Simulation results illustrate that, compared with the state-of-the-art methods, the proposed method has low computational complexity and its detection threshold can be analytically estimated.

articleTitle: Research on a Length Measurement Method of Graphite Electrode Based on Heat Conduction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the development of computer technology and sensor technology, the use of sensors to measure the length of electrodes and let computers replace manual control has become the development trend of intelligent measurement of electrodes in mine furnaces. Based on the theory of heat conduction, we propose a method to measure the length of the electrode by the difference in the relative point temperature information of the graphite electrode during operation. When the mine hot furnace is working normally, due to the temperature difference between the hot surface and the cold surface, heat transfer from the hot side to the cold side occurs on the electrode. At this point, we can use the difference between multiple temperature indication signals, the thermal conductivity of the electrode material, the heat flux at the same time, and the estimation of the temperature at the hot surface of the electrode to determine the position of the hot surface of the electrode and the length of the electrode at this moment. Electrode length measurements using thermodynamics are more accurate, while avoiding physical hazards to staff and further resource depletion.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Reconstruction Method of Transparent Object Based on Robot in-position Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Transparent parts are widely used in instrumentation, national defense, aerospace and other fields. These parts have strict operating environment and high optical performance requirements, and in-place measurement is the key to ensure their manufacturing requirements. However, transparent parts often have complex surface shapes and light transmission properties, which makes it difficult to meet the requirements of high-precision measurement. To solve this problem, this paper takes the aeronautical transparent parts as the object, and constructs a robot position measurement system based on spectral confocal sensor. Through the synchronous acquisition of sensor data and robot pose, the coordinate information of both sides of the transparent material is extracted in real time. On this basis, the NURBS algorithm is used to reconstruct the measured surface data, and the second-order geometric iterative algorithm is used to complete the optimal surface registration under unconstrained conditions. Finally, the evaluation of the measurement accuracy of surface parts is realized.

articleTitle: Responses Simulation of the electromagnetic Logging While Drilling tool in the fractured formation of horizontal well
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Low-frequency electromagnetic (EM) Logging While Drilling (LWD) has a deep detection depth, which can identify large-scale fractures and evaluate geometric parameters. In this paper, a rapid forward of EM LWD tool in fractured formations is realized by equivaling the fracture as a transition boundary conditions (TBC). A three-dimensional finite element method (FEM) was used to optimize the space and frequency of the tool, and the effects of fracture aperture and fracture elongation on the response characteristics of logging were analyzed. The results show that the equivalent fracture model has high accuracy and fast calculation speed. Electromagnetic wave logging in fractured formations, the response characteristics vary with the changes of fractures in different spatial positions, and the closer the fracture is to the tool, the more obvious is the response characteristics. And the larger space of the tool, the better fracture detection ability. The response characteristics change more obvious with the increasing the fracture aperture The tool can detect fractures with an elongation greater than the space of the tool. When the elongation is less than the tool space, “multi-resolution” occurs. The fast forward simulation results have good reference value for identifying position information of fracture beside well and EM LWD response.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Refractive Index Sensor Based on Waveguide Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper presents a new refractive index sensor based on the Fano resonance in optical phenomena. The sensor has two main parts: a metal-insulator-metal (MIM) as the base waveguide and a V -shaped ring resonant cavity with a convex outer ring (VRROR) as the coupling structure. The sensing characteristics of the structure are rationalized by applying the finite element method, and the specific effects of the various parameters in the structure on the sensitivity(S) and superiority of the VRROR are analyzed. The final sensitivity of the VRROR type sensor reaches 2960 nm/RIU, and the figure of merit (FOM) under the corresponding system reaches 51.3.

articleTitle: Research on Decoupling Control for Module Suspension System Based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The module suspension control of the Maglev train is divided into two levitation units, The control of suspension unit ignores the coupling effect between two suspension units, which reduces the levitation performance of the Maglev train. This paper take the suspension module suspension system as the research object. First, the model of a unilateral with double-points suspension model of the maglev system is established, which considering the coupling characteristics of two suspension units. The linear disturbance rejection control (LADRC) algorithm is used to design as the suspension point controller, which mainly includes the linear extended state observer (LESO) and the linear state error feedback control law (LSEF). Each points has its own control units. The LESO is designed to estimate the coupling effects and external disturbances of the system; the LSEF is designed to observe the internal dynamics and external disturbance information in real time and to estimate the “total disturbance” of the system. The coupling action is compensated for control to decouple the double-points suspension system into two independent second-order series integral-type subsystems. Comparing the PID control method with this method, the simulation results show that LADRC achieves decoupled control of the two-point suspension levitation system with fast response, tracking of the set signal, and strong anti-interference capability.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved Networked Radar Algorithm for Integrated Detection and Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of cooperative communication, cooperative detection and single-station detection tasks in the detection and communication integration networking radar, a new task scheduling algorithm is proposed in this article. The algorithm is designed to properly allocate radar time resources, rationally schedule cooperative tasks and single-station tasks, and improve the utilization rate of time resources and scheduling success rate. This algorithm can schedule both collaborative and single-station tasks. By assigning time windows for single-station tasks twice, the algorithm significantly improves the scheduling success rate and time utilization rate significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Blanket Eddy Current Testing in the Structural Deformation Test
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Eddy current testing is one of the common nondestructive testing of metal structure strain. It plays an irreplaceable role in metal testing and it can show the strain of metal structure directly. Comparing the existing eddy current detection technology, the traditional eddy current detection can only be carried out by artificially controlling the eddy current detection probe when measuring structural strain and stress deformation, large area detection is complicated, so a blanket eddy current detection probe is developed. The blanket eddy current detection can be used for real-time online monitoring and display the deformation condition and position of metal plate directly and accurately. Aiming at the problem of strain measurement of metal plate, different types of blanket eddy current testing are designed and carried out to test the structural strain condition, compare the structural deformation generating the phenomenon of induced voltage change, analyze the influence of coil with different turns, position and magnetic field direction on the structural strain. This paper provides a reference for the selection of non-metallic material structure monitoring methods and has great reference value for further research and development of new strain sensors and measuring instruments.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting Method of Residential District Based on Improved Feature Processing and Hybrid Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the load data of residential areas with fewer users is too sharp and steep, and the model is difficult to fit and the accuracy is low in short-term load forecasting, a load forecasting method based on improved feature processing and hybrid neural network. Firstly, a periodic feature mapping method is proposed, and the periodic feature of load data are obtained by this method. Then, the high-frequency noise in load data is filtered by using the improved filtering algorithm based on the sand cat swarm algorithm (SCSO) to solve the problem that the load data is too sharp and steep. Finally, the SCSO-MHA-GRU (SMG) hybrid prediction model is built, and the multi-head self-attention mechanism is introduced into the GRU network to improve the ability of the model to capture multiple input feature relationships. In this paper, the real power load data of a district in Jiangsu Province is used for experiment. The results show that the proposed method has stronger fitting ability and higher prediction accuracy than other comparison models in short-term load forecasting of residential districts with fewer users.

articleTitle: An Improved A* Algorithm for Four-way Shuttle Vehicle Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The goal of the traditional A* algorithm is to search for the shortest moving path, without considering the steering cost. Furthermore, collisions may occur during the operation of the four-way shuttle. In order to solve the described problem, an improved A* algorithm is proposed. The algorithm introduces a steering penalty factor to encourage the four-way shuttle to choose a path with fewer turns, and at the same time, a collision risk factor is introduced to avoid vehicle collisions. To verify the efficiency of the improved A* algorithm, compare the generation value of improved A* algorithm with that of traditional A* algorithm by randomly generating 5 sets of tasks with initial and ending positions, and by counting the completion time of all tasks, the efficiency of two algorithm under congestion, 5,10,15 vehicles is compared. Experimental simulation proves that the total generation value of the route is reduced and when the number of vehicles is increased, the completion time of improved A* algorithm is less.

articleTitle: Attitude Estimation Algorithm for Multi Rotor Aircraft Based on Extended Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The accuracy of attitude calculation is a prerequisite for achieving stable flight of multi rotor unmanned aerial vehicles. Currently, gyroscopes are commonly used to obtain the attitude angle of aircraft. However, there is a problem of drift in the gyroscope, and the long-term measurement accuracy is poor. Therefore, effective data processing is required for the output data of the gyroscope to obtain reliable and stable attitude angle information. The attitude angle of the carrier can be derived from the output data of the gyroscope through the kinematics differential equation, and its observation equation is nonlinear. The extended Kalman filtering algorithm is a commonly used algorithm for solving nonlinear problems of observation equations. The extended Kalman filter algorithm expands the nonlinear equation in Taylor series, removes the higher order terms above the second order, and linearizes the nonlinear equation. Its advantages are fast operation speed and strong real-time performance. In order to improve the attitude estimation accuracy of the aircraft, this paper uses the extended Kalman filter algorithm to achieve the attitude estimation of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Adaptability Analysis of Transient Overvoltage Prevention Control in AC/DC Power Grid Considering Uncertainty of High Ratio New Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Reactive power/voltage control is a prominent issue first exposed after the large-scale integration of new energy into the DC transmission end power grid. The uncertainty of new energy deepens the unpredictability of the future operation status of the power grid and the complexity of control decisions. The paper summarizes the manifestations of uncertainty in new energy, and takes an actual power grid as an example to simulate and analyze the adaptability of transient overvoltage prevention control in AC/DC power grids considering uncertainty of high proportion new energy. To enhance the adaptability and defense capabilities of prevention control, a prevention control framework should be developed based on local conditions and the impact characteristics of new energy uncertainty on the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on THz Waveguide-Microstrip Transition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A new W-band high-performance waveguide-microstrip probe transition was proposed in the background of THz high-performance transition design technology. THz technology is a key technology for future communication technology. In 75GHz~110GHz, the insertion loss of the waveguide-microstrip probe transition is between -1.8dB and - 3.6dB, and the return loss is less than -12dB. Based on the key interconnection technology mentioned above, a high-performance W-band LNA(LNA), of which the gain is above 21dB and the noise figure is lower than 5.2 has been developed.

articleTitle: Phase Demodulation under Free Undersampling in Heterodyne Coherent Φ-OTDR
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Heterodyne coherent detection phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometer <tex>$(\mathbf{\Phi}-\mathbf{OTDR})$</tex> is widely used in structural health monitoring of large facilities due to the ease of achieving stable phase demodulation, but it usually requires a high sampling rate. The sampling rate can be reduced effectively by undersampling, but the sampling rate of undersampling is strictly limited by spectrum aliasing effect. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a free undersampling phase demodulation method in the heterodyne coherent <tex>$\mathbf{\Phi}-\mathbf{OTDR}$</tex>. The method changes from traditional “distance” direction demodulation to “time” direction demodulation of the recombination signal. Therefore, the spectrum aliasing in the “distance” direction caused by undersampling does not affect the demodulation in the “time” direction, and the sampling rate of undersampling can be freely selected. In the experiment, we proposed method can accurately demodulate the phase in sampling rates of 100 MSa/s and 10 MSa/s that within the sample rate restricted area of conventional undersampling demodulation method.

articleTitle: An Error Estimation Method for Cooperative Detection Based on Bayesian Posterior
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In cooperative detection, the error would be highly nonlinear because of the different characteristics of platforms and sensors' error, which makes it difficult to obtain the optimal coordinates based on detection results from multiple platform. In this paper, a Bayesian posterior error estimation method for cooperative detection is designed. Based on designed Bayesian method, a reasonable analysis of the detection error is carried out. The first detection result is taken as a priori for the second detection in order to improve the accuracy of error estimation. The simulation verified that the variance of cooperative detection error is significantly reduced and reaches sub-meter level.

articleTitle: Analysis of Shielding Characteristics of MIT7530 Array Sensing Instrument Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Induction logging instrument is a kind of electrical instrument that is now used more frequently, and analyzing the influence of shielded coil on the receiving voltage is the premise to ensure that the voltage value is correct. This paper is based on the array induction instrument MIT7530 and starts from the basic principle of induction instrument logging. Visual Studio software is used to design a shielding characteristic analysis program, and the output data is read and written in the format of JSON files. The characteristics of the imaginary and real parts of the voltage values of the seven arrays at three frequencies were analyzed, and their characteristics changed with the number of turns and source distance of the shielded coil.

articleTitle: Blind Deconvolution-Based Localization Method by Matching Multipath Angle of Arrival in The Deep-Sea Direct Acoustic Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a blind deconvolution-based localization method by matching multipath angle of arrival in the deep-sea direct acoustic regions is proposed. A blind deconvolution method based on the Richardson-Lucy algorithm in the frequency domain is used to directly estimate the multiway arrival angle of the deep-sea acoustic source target, and the target localization is realized by matching the multiway arrival angle feature template of the acoustic field. This method overcomes the inapplicability of the conventional method in the long range of the direct acoustic region and the lower signal-to-noise ratio, and has higher localization accuracy and stability. Simulation and sea trial data validation show that the proposed method is significantly superior to conventional methods in terms of localization accuracy and robustness to environmental mismatch.

articleTitle: Automatic Planning UAV Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study proposes an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) system that combines computer vision object identification technology with laser positioning technology to increase the automation level and lower the expenses associated with developing infrastructure for unmanned farms. This system includes full-sphere perception, autonomous trip planning, and automatic return-to-home functionalities. The STM32F4 and Raspberry Pi are employed by the UAV system as the primary control chip and microcomputer system, respectively. The flight control system receives instructions for conducting flying actions based on information from the laser radar regarding its location and target detection data from the microcomputer system. As compared to conventional greenhouse automated spraying systems, which need expensive pipeline construction and maintenance costs, the suggested UAV system can significantly lower costs while attaining comparable spraying effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Learning-Based Classification Method for Painting Defect Detection of Balance Beam of Port Machinery
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A novel transfer learning-based classification method for steel structure painting defects recognition is designed, which is used to solve the problem of identifying painting defects in balance beams of port machinery. This paper proposes an AlexNet model based on transfer learning. Firstly, the weight of the original pre-training model is fine-tuned, and then the last full connection layer (FCL) in the AlexNet model is replaced. Finally, the target image data set is taken as the new input, and the weight of the model is fine-tuned through the back propagation mode, so as to realize the model migration. The experimental results show that the success rate of classification with and without defects can reach more than 93%; the success rate of point, line and surface defect classification reaches more than 88%;the accuracy rate for orange peel test reaches more than 91%. It can meet the requirements of defect detection and classification.

articleTitle: An Improved High Frequency Sine Wave Injection Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Sensorless Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the traditional high-frequency sine wave injection method, the use of many filters results in reduced accuracy of detection. Therefore, it is of great significance to simplify the filtering design and improve the accuracy of detection. Firstly, the band-pass filter extracting the high-frequency current with rotor information in the traditional method leads to phase lag. The phase-frequency characteristics of the band-pass filter is analyzed, and a modulation signal considering phase compensation is used to eliminate phase lag. Secondly, fundamental frequency currents are obtained by the difference between d and q axis currents and d and q axis high frequency response currents so that the two low-pass filters used to extract fundamental frequency currents are eliminated. Finally, to obtain a more accurate rotor position error signal, a second-order generalized integrator with better phase-frequency characteristics is used to replace the low-pass filter to extract the rotor position error signal. The simulation results claim that the improved way is better.

Author Keywords: pulsating high frequency sine wave injection

articleTitle: Ground Penetrating Radar Image De-Noising Method Based on Multi-Noise and Self-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The quality of ground penetrating radar (GPR) images is usually low due to unwanted noise interference such as antenna coupling, soil reflection, and industrial frequency interference, which often affects subsequent studies. Deep learning methods in the field of ground penetrating radar image denoising mainly include non-blind denoising studies based on a single additive Gaussian white noise, and blind denoising studies based on masks. Due to the presence of multiple composite noises in GPR images, methods based on such a single noise perform poorly in practical denoising work; and blind denoising deep learning methods based on image masking lose feature details of anomalous regions. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a multi-noise self-supervised denoising model MNSSDN for GPR image denoising, including a noise generator, a denoising generation network and a label pre-denoising module; meanwhile a corresponding loss function is designed to train the whole network. Firstly, the GPR image is input to the noise generator to obtain the image with random horizontal noise, and then passed into the denoising generation network for denoising. Next, integrate them into one fusion image. Finally, the output of the label pre-denoising module is used as the label for backpropagation to constrain the evolution direction of the network.

articleTitle: Merged Intersection Over Union: A Metric and a Loss for Aerial Images in Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the development of information technology and new energy, efficient power inspection is crucial for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In recent years, State Grid of China has vigorously promoted intelligent transmission line inspection, gradually replacing the initial manual inspection of transmission lines with Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection. The UAV inspection mainly relies on UAV high-altitude collection of transmission line images, and uses object detection (OD) and recognition algorithms to automatically determine various device defects in the transmission line. Due to the current mainstream OD methods using IoU to measure the degree of overlap between the predicted box and the real box, IoU is not only unable to measure scenes where the object boxes do not coincide, but also extremely sensitive to small-scale object position changes. If we continue to use IoU to measure high-altitude transmission line defect objects with large scale span, the OD algorithm model cannot achieve better performance. In order to alleviate this problem, we propose a new evaluation metric method, which is the Merged Intersection Over Union (MIoU). MIoU is a plug and play component that can be embedded into label assignment and loss function of any anchor-based detector to replace commonly used IoU metric. We conducted experiments on the MIoU performance in the transmission line component fault dataset, and a large number of experiments showed that using our proposed metric model improved 6.8% AP compared to the benchmark model, and significantly improved the recall rate of the model on certain key defect classes.

articleTitle: Accrute Measurement of Two-Dimensional Grid Based on Micro-Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A two-dimensional grid measurement method based on computer micro-vision technology to improve the measuring precision is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the noise of the image is eliminated by the median filtering technology, and then edge detection is realized by canny detector to obtain closed contour curve. Secondly, the shape angle D<inf>a</inf> is used for rough classification of contour curves. Then, the edge points of the grid are fitted and filled to form a regular geometry shape, which can be accurately identify by using the hough transform algorithm. Finally, in order to verify the validity of the method, 10 feature points of 2um two-dimensional grid template are measured in the x direction and the y direction, the experimental results show that the error of measuring grid with the method studied in this paper is less than 0.1 μ m. Therefore, this method reveals the possibility of high-precision measurement of two-dimensional grid through computer micro-vision, and makes it be a much better option to be employed for further micro-nano structures analysis applications.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Switching Frequency Reduction Based on LCL Multivariable
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traditional grid connected predictive control is based on the inverter output current as the control object. The grid connected predictive control based on LCL multivariable further improves the control effect by introducing capacitor voltage and grid side current. The switching frequency of the inverter is too high, which hinders the prediction of switching frequency. Aiming at the high switching frequency of inverter in model prediction, combined with hysteresis control theory, a hysteresis model predictive control strategy is designed. This method evaluates the rationality of the error range according to the set hysteresis width, and judges the best switching state by comparing and analyzing the hysteresis width and error prediction value. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method effectively reduces the switching frequency predicted by the model.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Visual Logging Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Chinese continental shale oil and gas reserves are abundant, but the scale commercial development is facing a huge challenge, and the supporting technologies for effective development need to be further explored. Horizontal well drilling and large-scale stage multi-cluster pressure technology equipment develop rapidly. Fracturing evaluation is a technical shortcoming that needs to be solved urgently. The ultra-wide-angle visual detection technology realizes the measurement of perforation through the correction, expansion and reconstruction processing of video images, which can be used for perforation abrasion detection and horizontal well fracturing evaluation, and is involved in the Changing shale oil development experiment. Using visual data analysis to quantify downhole characteristics, the feasibility of ultra-wide-angle visual instrument in perforating abrasion and fracturing evaluation is proved.

articleTitle: Degradation Trajectory Tracking of MOSFETs Based on Machine Learning and CEEMDAN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: MOSFET is one of the most popular silicon carbide power electronic devices, is widely popular in base station, energy storage, aerospace and railway scenarios. As one of the score electronic components in power electronic system, power MOSFETs degradation performance is closely related to the overall operation of power of power electronic system, which directly affects the stability and security of the system. In this work, taking the MOSFETs accelerated thermal aging datasets provided by NASA as the research project, we proposed a deep extreme learning based on CEEMDAN(complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition) with adaptive noise to simulate the degradation trend of MOSFETs. The experimental results show that the method can fit the degradation trend well on the high noise dataset.

articleTitle: Mobile Composite Robotic Arm Modelling and External Coupling Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a general coordination approach is proposed to realize the cooperative work between the mobile chassis and the redundant robotic arm in the task space through external coupling. The motion of the mobile robotic arm is regulated by controlling the weight ratio of the objective function of each constraint. Firstly, the kinematics of the chassis is analyzed in detail according to the kinematic model of the mobile chassis and the robotic arm, and then the inverse kinematics of the redundant robotic arm based on a combination of analytical and geometric methods is used to solve for the angle values of each joint of the robotic arm, and then the velocity mapping from the joint space to the task space and the geometric Jacobi matrix of the generic form are introduced according to the kinematic model of the mobile robotic arm. Based on this, the strong coupling motion of the mobile robotic arm is achieved by combining the constrained objective function with an external coordinated coupling according to the arm's own configuration and the adapted operating characteristics, and finally the effectiveness of the method is verified in the ROS operating system.

articleTitle: Study of Calibration Laws for Distributed Fibre Optic Temperature Sensing Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, two kinds of optical fibers with 0.6mm outer diameter and ETFE sheath and 0.9mm outer diameter and Hytrel sheath were subjected to continuous temperature measurement and calibration experiments, and three water bath calibration experiments were conducted on optical fibers by BOTDR. The Brillouin frequency shift in the initial temperature rise test is close to the initial value, but as the temperature increases, the Brillouin frequency shift will approach a constant value. There are two main reasons for this phenomenon: on the one hand, the coefficient of thermal expansion of the fiber jacket material is larger than that of the core silica, resulting in a certain amount of compression of the core by the fiber jacket during the warming process, thus offsetting some of the core expansion caused by the temperature, making the Brillouin frequency shift change weaker, and the thicker the jacket, the more significant this compression effect is, the lower the temperature coefficient of the fiber. On the other hand, the Brillouin frequency shift in the cooling experiment is related to the thickness of the fiber sheath material. As the temperature in the water bath increases, the thicker the sheath, the stronger the compression of the core, which causes the Brillouin shift to change.

articleTitle: Container and Microservice-Based Resource Management for Distribution Station Area
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Container and microservice-based resource management approach can achieve the processing and computation of massive and highly concurrent service data in distribution station area. However, resource management in distribution station area still faces the challenge of large data computation delay and inability to achieve service priority awareness. In this paper, a container and microservice-based resource management architecture is constructed, and an upper confidence bound (UCB)-based resource management capability optimization algorithm is proposed to minimize data computation delay. The algorithm can resolve the conflicts between differentiated microservices and achieve more rational exploration by considering microservice priorities to improve resource utilization. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has superior performance in data computation delay with differentiated microservice priorities.

articleTitle: An Autofocus Method for Backprojection Algorithm in Range Compression Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Backprojection (BP) algorithm is the classic time-domain imaging method for synthetic aperture radar (SAR). The quality of BP imaging results relies on the accuracy of motion measurement, for which autofocus is often important in BP algorithm for airborne imaging. Traditional autofocus methods for frequency domain SAR imaging algorithms, such as phase gradient autofocus (PGA) can hardly be applied in BP algorithm. The most studied autofocus methods for BP, such as the maximum sharpness method or generalized phase gradient autofocus method, need large amount of memory or computation. In this work, we present an autofocus algorithm which is achieved before imaging for BP algorithm. The approach is based on the feature of strong scatterer in range compression domain, from which we can estimate the real trajectory of antenna phase centers and compensate the corresponding motion error and Doppler modulation phase. This algorithm holds the same concept as PGA, but it is applied before imaging to utilize the advantage of BP algorithm. The algorithm can be applied for wide scene with little computational amount. Simulation and experimental results are demonstrated to prove the efficacy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Radar Countermeasure Knowledge Augmented Deep Adaptive Jamming Policy Decision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The absence of representative training data on actual radar countermeasure environment, leads to the low learning efficiency, policy gradient divergence, and poor generalization ability of jamming decision agent. To solve this problem, we propose a framework of deep adaptive jamming policy agent augmented with radar countermeasure knowledge. It can be formulated as optimal jamming decision path searching, by constructing a hierarchical jamming knowledge tree, and utilizing Monte Carlo Tree Search applied in deep reinforcement learning. Given the credit to radar countermeasure knowledge augmentation and jamming techniques hierarchical optimization, the simulation results demonstrate that compared with traditional q-learning and hierarchical reinforcement learning, the complexity of policy searching is significantly reduced, meanwhile the learning rate of adaptive jamming policy is highly acelerated.

articleTitle: Balance Control of Quadruped Robot under External Disturbance using Quadratic Programming and Impedance Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Legged robots are widely used in complex environments because of their strong motion flexibility and environmental adaptability. However, uncertain external disturbances in complex environments will bring adverse effects on the stability and motion state of robots in the actual working process. For quadruped robot operating under external disturbance in complex environment, a dynamic balance control framework based on QP (quadratic programming) method and impedance control is proposed in this paper. The whole robot control system adopts dynamic control scheme. We use the single rigid body model to simplify the dynamics model of the quadruped robot, and use QP with friction cone constraint to optimize the desired foot contact forces, and achieve the optimal distribution of foot contact force. Impedance control is used to smoothly control the swing leg of a quadruped robot, which greatly reduces the impact of the swing leg and the ground on the robot body. In this paper, the A1 quadruped robot of Unitree Technology was simulated by Webots. The experiments showed that A1 quadruped robot could resist 60N lateral impact force and continuous external drag force, which verified the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Grid Line Galloping Analysis Using Euler Angle Attitude Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Analyzing galloping behavior is to develop effective countermeasures to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This paper presents a novel approach to estimating grid line galloping using an inertial measurement unit (IMU) device, the Euler angle method, and the Mahony filter. The proposed method effectively estimates the displacement of transmission lines. This method is validated through simulated and experimental data, demonstrating its ability to accurately estimate galloping displacement. In comparison to existing methods, the proposed approach is simpler, more efficient, and requires fewer sensors. The Mahony filter ensures accurate and robust estimation of the Euler angles, while the Euler angle method and IMU device offer an efficient and practical means of estimating grid line displacement. This research has significant implications for the development of more effective and efficient methods for monitoring and controlling grid stability.

articleTitle: Study on the Method for Determining the Alternatives' Priority Weights in Different Cross-Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The operation and maintenance of transmission lines carry out real-time monitoring of the environment and equipment conditions through different cross-system, such as fixed video monitoring system, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) monitoring system, regional manual inspection system, etc., and the health level of the transmission lines can be evaluated and analyzed by using integrated data. It is difficult to determine objective weight of different cross-system data. In this paper, a new method for determining the alternatives' priority weights of different cross-system data is proposed, the importance of cross-system data is compared in pairs, and a complementary judgment matrix is constructed, and the least square method is used to solve the decision weight of cross-system data, and a consistency test is carried out. Relevant results can provide the basis for scientific decision-making for transmission line data fusion.

articleTitle: Underwater Terrain Measurement Based on Unmanned Measurement Ship Multi-Beam Bathymeter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Underwater topographic survey is the surveying and mapping work to measure the plane position and elevation of rivers, lakes, oceans, channels and harbors, and draw underwater topographic maps. With the development of China's economy, progress in technology, and acceleration of infrastructure construction, the combination of GNSS RTK and multi beam bathymetry by unmanned surveying ships has improved the problems of personnel safety and low measurement accuracy in traditional underwater terrain surveying methods. This article introduces the principle and method of multi beam bathymetry, as well as the GNSS-RTK three-dimensional bathymetry technology. Combined with engineering examples, it analyzes the integrated RTK three-dimensional bathymetry system of unmanned measurement ship multi beam bathymetry system, providing a new method and idea for underwater terrain measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on GWO-CS Optimized SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A combined Grey Wolf Optimization and Cuckoo Search algorithm, called GWOCS, has been proposed to address the issue of low accuracy in dissolved gas analysis for transformer fault diagnosis. The GWOCS algorithm is applied to optimize the Support Vector Machine (SVM) for transformer fault diagnosis in power systems. The performance of the GWOCS algorithm is tested using two typical test functions, and it has been demonstrated that GWOCS algorithm has stronger stability and search ability. By using GWOCS to optimize the key parameters of SVM, a GWOCS-SVM transformer fault diagnosis model is established. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional GWO-SVM model, the GWOCS-SVM model improves the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis by 7%. This highlights the convenience, necessity, and effectiveness of using intelligent algorithms to find optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Industrial Internet of Things Gateway Based on ESP32
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The digital transformation of the manufacturing industry has led to the rise of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) for production management. To overcome the challenge of collecting diverse data within the MES system, we developed a wireless Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) gateway based on the ESP32 module. This gateway enables the configuration of data collection and transmission parameters through the upper computer and utilizes the S7 and MQTT protocols for data extraction, protocol conversion, and cloud integration. System testing confirms its effectiveness in wirelessly connecting and collecting data from up to 16 PLC devices, including 1200 industrial controllers.

articleTitle: An IGBT Dynamic Characteristic Control Method Based on Miller Capacitance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the increase of switching frequency, the turn-on current overshoot and turn-off voltage overshoot generated by IGBT switching moment are also increasing rapidly. Under the action of stray inductance, the voltage spike on the circuit load is increasing. Aiming at the problem, an active control circuit based on Miller capacitance is proposed in this paper. The active control circuit takes <tex>$du_{ce}/dt$</tex> and <tex>$di_{ce}/dt$</tex> as the control signals, which only increases the Miller capacitance of IGBT at the moment of switching, so as to reduce the switching energy loss while effectively suppressing voltage overshoot. Compared with traditional control circuits, the circuit also has the advantages of simple circuit structure, not changing the existing IGBT driving circuit, and easy to integrate with the existing driver. The performance of the designed circuit is verified by simulation software and experimental platform. The results show that the designed circuit can greatly reduce voltage overshoot and current overshoot.

articleTitle: Fault Identification Method of T-Connection Transmission Line Built on Backward Traveling Wave Energy Cross Entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low accuracy and poor robustness of traditional fault diagnosis for T -connected transmission lines, a fault diagnosis algorithm for T -connected transmission lines based on backward traveling wave energy cross entropy was proposed. Based on S-transform, the cross entropy of the sum of the backward traveling wave current energy of the short time sequence corresponding to 10 frequencies at the two measuring points of the T-connected transmission line is calculated, and the cross entropy calculated from the 6 short time sequences is taken as the sample set to characterize the fault characteristics. Combined with random forest neural network, the characteristic samples are trained and tested to diagnose the fault of T -connected transmission lines. After extensive simulation experiments and analysis, it was found that the proposed method not only accurately identifies the branch where the fault is located, but also has certain anti-interference capabilities.

articleTitle: Intelligent Condensation Irrigation System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the shortage of water resources leading to ecological damage, crop yield reduction and environmental pollution, it is important to realize remote intelligent condensation irrigation based on IoT. This paper uses ESP32 IOT cloud platform, soil humidity sensor, air temperature and humidity sensor to form a remote data collection system, ESP32 IOT cloud platform, condensation water collection equipment, optocoupler relay, solenoid water valve, ultrasonic humidifier to form an intelligent irrigation system, and photovoltaic energy generation to form a set of intelligent condensation irrigation system based on IOT. The system is based on MQTT Internet of Things communication technology, which can obtain the environmental data of the equipment in real time, use the semiconductor condensation technology to liquefy the water resources in the air, extract the water resources for irrigation in real time according to the environmental data, and provide power by photovoltaic energy generation. This intelligent irrigation system saves human and material resources, has low energy consumption, strong communication in real time, and can realize the effect of condensing water extraction for irrigation.

articleTitle: Design of Open and Close Magnetic Core Weak Current Sensor Based on Tunneling Magnetoresistance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The application of current sensing technology in power system has achieved remarkable results under the rapid development of smart grid and ubiquitous power Internet of Things. A non-invasive weak current sensor based on tunneling magnetoresistive effect is studied in order to meet the application requirements of detecting the grounding current of 110kV single-core power cable safely and reliably. A two-lobe square fillet magnetic core structure is designed, and a voltage stabilizing circuit with isolated power supply and an instrument amplifier circuit with floating common-mode bootstrap structure are designed based on the closed-loop principle. By analyzing the test data of the sensor, the non-invasive weak current sensor based on tunneling magnetoresistive effect designed in this paper has a range of 0-20mA, and has a sensitivity of 20m V/mA and a linearity of 0.52% in this range. Compared with the closed magnetic core structure, the open-close magnetic core structure meets the needs of easy disassembly of the sensor and broadens the application scenarios of the sensor. TMR current sensor has a wider range and higher linearity, which can meet the accurate detection of grounding current.

articleTitle: Balance Loss for MultiAttention-Based YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming to address the advantages and disadvantages of various target detection algorithms, we optimized the data augmentation algorithm, attention mechanism and loss backpropagation function across different neural networks, and proposed an improved YOLOv4-based target detection algorithm. The new model introduces a Mixup algorithm with Mosaic in the data augmentation block, adds a multi-attention block that includes channel attention and spatial attention between the backbone and FPN, and replaces CIoU in the Loss function with Balance IoU and cascade confidence loss called Balance Loss to enhance the neural network's target detection capability. We trained and validated the improved algorithm in the VOC2007 dataset, and experimental results showed that this algorithm has a more robust feature extraction capability and higher target detection accuracy than the original YOLOv4 algorithm. The mAP increases by 1.2%. The model also performs better in detecting small and medium target objects.

articleTitle: Research on Obstacle Avoidance Tracking Control Method for Unmanned Vehicles Based on Model Predictive Control in Variable Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the obstacle avoidance tracking control problem of unmanned vehicles, a model predictive controller is designed in this paper. The controller adopts a layered structure. The upper layer performs local path planning during obstacle avoidance based on the nonlinear vehicle point-mass model, and the lower layer implements path tracking based on the monorail vehicle dynamics model. Through the joint simulation of Carsim and Matlab, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the controller parameters, and the performance of the controller is tested at different speeds. The simulation results show that: compared with the controller before improvement, the controller is at 30km/h, 60km/h and 80km/h, the lateral deviation after obstacle avoidance decreased by 34.8%, 47.2%, and 13% respectively, and the yaw angle deviation decreased by 18.7%, 49.9%, and 29% respectively, Finally, smooth obstacle avoidance at various speeds is achieved through layered control.

articleTitle: Rapid Identification Method for the Sudden Change of Operating Errors in Smart Electricity Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The sudden change of operating errors is a critical problem for the online monitoring of electricity meters at present. In this paper, we propose a fast identification method based on the matching of line loss residual distribution characteristic approximation, in an attempt to realize the error estimation and sudden change moment localization of electricity meters with sudden change in operating errors.
