First of all, based on Kirchhoff's law, a line loss mathematical model that accurately takes into account the power load information is constructed to achieve accurate quantification of line loss (LL), and the line loss coefficient and the operating error estimation of electricity meters during the training period are obtained through nonlinear constraint optimization; consequently, on the basis of the distribution characteristics of line loss residuals in the blind period, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm is used to select the corresponding reference period in the form of approximation matching; finally, in conformity to the difference in the characters of line loss residuals in the reference period and the blind period, a variety of statistical indicators are used to comprehensively judge the out-of-tolerance electricity meter and its out-of-tolerance range. The simulation analysis and the experimental verification results in the actual station confirm the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Review of Bionic Polarized Light Localization Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Bionic polarized light localization is derived from the navigation mechanism exploration of natural organisms, which has the advantages of autonomous anti-interference and non-accumulation of errors, and can be used as an important navigation means for long-endurance unmanned systems. Bionic polarized light positioning mainly includes the measurement of atmospheric polarization mode, the solution of the sun's position, and the solution of the carrier's longitude and latitude. According to the solution logic, this paper details the research situation and basic principles of each step, and finally analyzes the key problems of bionic polarized light positioning research.

articleTitle: Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on ICHOA-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is affected by many factors. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of short-term photovoltaic power, a prediction model based on Pearson coefficient method, improved Chimpanzee algorithm (ICHOA) and gate selected cycle unit (GRU) was proposed. Firstly, Pearson correlation coefficient was used to obtain the main factors affecting photovoltaic power generation, which reduced the computational complexity of the model. Then, the chimpanzee algorithm combined with elite reverse learning and adaptive mutation is used to optimize the relevant hyperparameters of GRU network, and the photovoltaic power generation is predicted under the condition of obtaining the optimal hyperparameters. The simulation results of a power station in Australia show that the MAE of the proposed model is reduced by 26.83%, under different weather conditions, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method

articleTitle: Application of Soft-Decision Decoding Algorithm for Convolution Coding of M-ary Spread Spectrum Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Spread Spectrum Communication can effectively improve the anti-interference capability of the system, so it is widely used. As frequency band resources become more and more crowded, the increasing attention is paid to M-ary Spread Spectrum because of its function to balance bandwidth and transmission rate. Synchronization has always been the key technology in the M-ary Spread Spectrum. This paper compares the error performance of the synchronous head synchronization method and the reference signal synchronization method. In this paper, the soft digital method is used as the output of digital modulation and demodulation to the decoder. Based on the log-likelihood ratio, a suboptimal soft information extraction method suitable for M-ary Spread Spectrum System is proposed, and the influenced of hard decision and soft decision on the system is analyzed. The simulation results show that improvement the error performance of the system is unsignificant improved by the decision, The method of judgment after simply extracting soft information does not significantly improve the system error code performance. When the convolutional coding is added, the error performance of the whole system is improved by the simulation parameter invariant analysis, which is about 5.2dB compared with that of the DSSS (Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum) system. Soft decision decoding has a gain of about 2dB over hard decision decoding. Considering the coding efficiency, the influence of soft decision and hard decision on the error performance of the system is analyzed separately. The results show that the error performance of the system is greatly gain compared with high signal-to-noise ratio. When the bit error rate <tex>$\boldsymbol{BER=1\times 10^{-3}}$</tex>, the soft decision decoding has about 0.7dB gain compared with the hard decision decoding. Soft decision decoding on the whole system error performance has 2.5dB gain.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Tracing Method of Social Network Rumor Information Based on Node Importance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To enhance the speed of tracing rumor information in social networks and shorten the traceability error distance, this paper proposes a node importance ranking algorithm based on node location information and structural attributes. On the one hand, the algorithm improves the computing performance of node location attributes through the iterative information generated by each iterative process in K-kernel decomposition. On the other hand, combined with the current state of network nodes, the concepts of relation topology and information topology are proposed, and a candidate source expansion algorithm based on information topology is designed, this algorithm first extracts the features of the rumor data, then maps them to the classifier, and realizes the rumor traceability of the social network according to the mapped path length, path depth, character length and other features. The experimental results demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper can effectively identify malicious information sources, and the distance between the propagation source located by this method and the real propagation source is also very close (within 1.4 hops on average).

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Model Based on time-frequency Dual Channel and Improved Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Fault diagnosis plays an important role in the normal operation of rolling bearing. The traditional diagnosis methods have some limitations, such as low diagnosis accuracy, large sample size, poor interpretability and so on. In view of the above defects, this paper takes the feature extraction and modeling analysis of small sample signals as the research goal. According to the different characteristics of time-domain and frequency-domain signals, the time-domain channel based on bidirectional long-short term memory network and the frequency-domain channel based on convolutional neural networks are designed to extract the dual channel features of fault signals; The traditional attention mechanism structure is improved, and a space channel two-dimensional attention module is designed to weight the global information importance of the signal. Experiments show that the diagnosis model designed in this paper can achieve high diagnosis accuracy under the conditions of small samples and less training times, so as to realize the accurate identification and classification of bearing faults.

articleTitle: Quality-Related Fault Detection Based on Dynamical-Improved Canonical Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Dynamic Canonical Correlation Analysis (DCCA), as an extension variant of canonical correlation analysis, it employs the autoregressive exogenous(ARX) time series extension method to extend the CCA model to dynamic scenarios, facilitating dynamic feature extraction and prediction of key performance indicators. However, in DCCA, the process variable space variables may contain components that are either irrelevant or have a negligible contribution for predicting quality, while the residual space may contain components with significant fluctuations. To overcome these limitations, a Dynamical-Improved canonical correlation analysis (DICCA) model is proposed. Firstly, the principal components were seperated into two blocks, i.e., quality-related subspace and quality-unrelated subspace. Secondly, a PCA decomposition was performed to separate the quality-related components in the residual space. Thirdly, the statistics were designed for each of the four spaces and conducted the online testing, representively. Finally, the effectiveness of the DICCA algorithm is demonstrated through its application to the Tennessee-Eastman (TE) process experiment.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Finite-Time PID Control Method with Gain Tuning by Frequency Domain Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Modern control theory has developed vigorously so far, and most of them are still the PD type controller. However, PID control is still applied in most practical industries. Therefore, the PD type feedback control in this paper is improved to nonlinear finite-time PID control under time domain state space model for affine nonlinear systems. Concretely, the feedback linearization method is adopted to do the coordinate transformation of the nonlinear system and then the nonsmooth controller is skillfully designed. This closed-loop system is proved to be finite-time stable by Lyapunov method. Compared with the time domain analysis, frequency domain analysis can observe the potential robustness metrics of control system to tune the control gain. Considering that the frequency domain analysis exists obstacles for the nonlinear system, linear parameter-varying framework is adopted for the nonlinear system under the proposed method for further analysis, which is conducive to the better gain tuning of the control system. At last, simulations of the controls of data based electrostatic precipitator models are given for the validation of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Centralized Control Management of Hydroelectric Station in River Basin under Different Weather Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a maturely developed, clean and efficient renewable energy source, hydropower is the main realization of the transformation of power resources nowadays, and the research of hydropower intelligent control system is helpful for the sustainable development requirements of hydropower development. Controlling the inflow and outflow of hydroelectric systems is a critical issue in coordinating system power generation and system regulation performance, especially when there are extreme weather effects. In this paper, a semi-dynamic multi-objective flow optimization model is established for the lower Yalong River as the study area, and the model can satisfy the trade-off between system power generation and system regulation under different scenarios. Combining the realistic situation from the perspective of hydroelectric control system considering extreme weather conditions, we set up a normal weather scenario, a small-scale cyclic extreme weather scenario, and a large-scale cyclic extreme weather scenario. The system power generation and system regulation performance are taken as the optimization objectives, and an improved reservoir capacity rating coefficient is used to quantify the regulation performance. Three different weather scenarios are set, and the solution algorithm is based on the dynamic multi-objective evolutionary algorithm with non-dominated ranking(DNSGA-II).The results in the study area show that the model can adapt to different weather conditions to coordinate the two objectives of system power generation and system regulation performance, both of which are weakened by severe weather conditions, with the most significant effect being Jinping I reservoir. The preliminary application of the proposed approach in the lower Yalong River basin demonstrates the potential for locally centralized control management of hydroelectric stations, providing reference significance for further research and application.

articleTitle: Particle Filter Based on Improved Gravitation Field Algorithm for 3D Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: State estimation is the key stage of target tracking. Particle Filter (PF) as a method to solve the state estimation problem has been applied to target tracking. However, PF has some problems such as particle degradation and algorithm redundancy. To solve these problems, an Improved Gravitation Field Algorithm-based Particle Filter (IGFA-PF) is proposed in this paper. IGFA-PF introduces the gravitation field algorithm after the sampling step of PF to guide the particles to move to the high likelihood region, so as to adjust the particle distribution, with the purpose of reducing particle degradation. Meanwhile, divide-and-conquer sampling method is used to divide the state space and independently sample particles in each subspace, so as to reduce algorithm redundancy and improve real-time performance. Finally, IGFA-PF is used to track a 3D moving target. The results of the simulation show that IGFA-PF can estimate the target state more accurately and has better tracking performance.

articleTitle: A Stereo Vision-Based Flexible Deflection Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper aims at measuring deflection of mainly beam structures in a non-contact, installation-free and marker-less way with the aid of stereo vision, edge detecting, projection transformation, spline interpolation among other data processing methods. A measurement scheme covering the hardware system design and data analyzing is proposed. Things relevant to stereo vision mainly convert a position in image to a real world position. The edge detection is used to recognize features in images that are essential for measuring deflection. The projection to a certain plane is a reasonable design due to the structure of the targeted structures. And spline interpolation compensates for the loss of obtaining the coordinates of discrete points of the target object. Then an experiment is carried out. And the result proves the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved PFC-PID Control Based on CFPSO for Heat Exchanger Outlet Temperature System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large delay and poor anti-disturbance ability in the outlet temperature control system of the heat exchanger, to optimize the control accuracy of the system and improve the control performance, this paper proposes a control scheme combining predictive functional control (PFC) with proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control. And using the particle swarm optimization algorithm with compression factor (CFPSO) to tune its parameters. Using the incremental PID control algorithm to improve the optimization objective function of the PFC algorithm, a PFC-PID optimization model with a proportional-integral-derivative structure is established. The CFPSO algorithm is applied to the parameter optimization of the improved PFC-PID control system, which overcomes the disadvantage that the traditional PID control parameters are difficult to tune. The control scheme proposed in this paper is compared with conventional PID control and cascade PFC-PID control by simulation. The results show that the scheme has a fast response speed and strong interference suppression ability. It significantly improves the adaptability and stability of the system, and can effectively control the outlet temperature of the heat exchanger.

articleTitle: Human-Machine Co-Driving Mode Switching Method of Autonomous Vehicles based on Traffic Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Human-machine co-driving is a commonly used vehicle control mode in automatic driving. The human-machine co-driving mode switching model of multi-objective autonomous vehicles is designed in traffic scenes. The ADHDP iterative interactive verification is carried out to realize the human-machine co-driving mode switch of autonomous vehicles. The final test results showed that test in different target driving distance, comparing with the traditional hybrid switching test groups, characteristics of target handoff method finally concluded relatively fast switching speed. It also shows that this design method has better stability, switch in the switching process, fast, can achieve smooth switching smoothly, has a certain practical significance.

articleTitle: RHSOA: Receding Horizon Optimization-Based Swift Obstacle Avoidance Approach for UAVs in Unknown Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach, called RHSOA, for real-time obstacle avoidance control of nonlinear systems in dynamic environments, considering safety and speed for UAVs. The approach relies on the integration of nonlinear receding horizon optimization (RHO), joint control Lyapunov functions (CLFs), and control barrier functions (CBFs). The proposed method is aimed at achieving close-to-optimal obstacle avoidance control for the demand of real-time obstacle avoidance in unknown dynamic environments of UAVs. The method is divided into two main parts: firstly, the classification of obstacles is pre-processed, and a safety-enveloping ellipse is proposed to associate obstacles, which reduces the computational workload. Secondly, the RHO is improved under the limited time, taking into account both rapidity and safety priority. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by comparing simulation results and performance metrics. The results show that the proposed method achieves superior performance and outperforms some existing approaches.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Multi-Component Gas Logging Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: with the continuous deepening of oil and gas exploration and development, unconventional, composite and other complex oil and gas reservoirs have gradually become the focus of exploration and development. At present, the gas logging analysis technology commonly used in the drilling process of oil and gas wells can only analyze light hydrocarbon components before nC<inf>5</inf>. In fact, more hydrocarbon components such as C<inf>6</inf> + are not effectively used, which makes the identification of reservoir fluid properties inaccurate, especially in some complex oil and gas wells will reveal greater limitations. Therefore, use multi-component gas logging data to achieve the evaluation of reservoir fluid properties and the quantitative drilling fluid degassed by gas degasser to achieve constant temperature and pressure degassing and fast chromatography, combined with quality control, parameter correction, use template for interpretation of specific fluid properties to achieve more accurate evaluation of reservoir fluid properties. It is of great practical importance and high application value for oilfield production.

articleTitle: Adaptive Target Birth Intensity Based on Scene Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The effective multi-target detection and tracking has always been a research hotspot in the field of radar, and there are many factors that affect the performance of the algorithm for multi-target tracking. Aiming at the target birth issue, this paper proposes an adaptive target birth intensity method based on scene optimization. This method is mainly applied to the radar long-term continuous monitoring scenario, and the monitoring area is divided into the target-birth consideration area and non-target-birth consideration area by some prior information of the monitoring area and the target status. And then the target birth process in the target-birth consideration area is strengthened, while the clutter interference from the non-target-birth consideration area is eliminated, so as to improve the target tracking performance and processing efficiency. Finally, the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm are verified by simulation experiments and analysis.

articleTitle: Indoor Sound Source Location Algorithm Based on Hybrid Kernel Function QPSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To improve the positioning accuracy of indoor sound source location systems under adverse acoustic conditions such as low signal-to-noise ratio and strong reverberation, an improved sound source location method based on support vector machine classification is proposed. Firstly, the feature vectors of each location are calculated by phase transformation weighted cross-correlation function, and a new mixing function is constructed, A new SVM classification model with cross- correlation function as feature vector is proposed, and quantum particle swarm optimization is used to comprehensively optimize the penalty coefficient, kernel function and mixing coefficient of SVM, to improve the generalization ability and learning ability of SVM classifier, thus improving the positioning accuracy of SVM model. The indoor sound source location algorithm based on the mixed kernel function QPSO-SVM is realized. The algorithm is trained in the noise-free reverberation sound source scene, and the test data of the multi-source scene are evaluated experimentally under different reverberation intensities and signal-to-noise ratios. The research shows that under the conditions of low SNR and high reverberation, the algorithm in this paper significantly improves the accuracy of indoor sound source location, and the accuracy is at least 30% higher than that of the traditional location algorithm and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID with Active Disturbance Rejection Control for a Two-axis Gimbal
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Compared with existing control algorithms for two-axis gimbal, ordinary PID or cascade PID has certain stability, but its dynamic performance is far from the engineering requirements, especially when the gimbal is under different loads and external non-ideal multi-source disturbance environments, the simple PID controller cannot achieve the control accuracy. Aims to improve the dynamic control performance of the two-axis gimbal, this paper proposes an anti-disturbance control method based on ADRC, which fully combines the physical model of the gimbal and uses the Extended State Observer (ESO) to observe the system state and controller output and compensates based on the observed disturbance. Meanwhile, to meet the dynamic performance of the controller, a cascade fuzzy PID controller is used, and dynamic PID parameters are used for adaptive control according to different loads and gimbal states. This controller design is the first of its kind to innovatively propose compensation for external disturbances and adaptive control using fuzzy PIDs according to different loads. Finally, through a series of comparative experiments, the proposed controller is validated, and compared with the traditional cascade PID controller, the fuzzy anti-disturbance gimbal controller proposed in this paper can make the gimbal exhibit stability and robustness under various disturbances and load conditions.

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Testing of Rebars in Concrete
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) technology is widely used in the detection and positioning of rebars in concrete, and the distribution of rebars is the key to the quality of structures. At present, the positioning of rebars by GPR depends on the hyperbola fitting after threshold segmentation of B-SCAN. In the case of complex B-SCAN, the existing methods have poor positioning effect on the apex of the hyperbola. At the same time, it cannot meet the requirements for real-time positioning of rebars at the scene.This paper proposes a CUDS-based (Column Up and Down Scan) location method for the vertex of the hyperbola formed by the reabr. By detecting the ROI at the top of the hyperbola formed by the rebar, the symmetry axis of the hyperbola is restricted to corresponding to the wave interval for the vertex of A-SCAN. Then use CUDS to realize the precise positioning of the vertex position of the hyperbola. In order to be able to apply on the mobile terminal with poor computing resources, the lightweight processing of pruning and knowledge distillation is performed on the ROI detection model. This paper combines the detection method of rebar and deploys it on the mobile terminal. In the actual detection of the physical model, the positioning accuracy of the rebar reaches 1.6mm, which is higher than the existing method C3, which verifies the effectiveness of the results of this paper.

articleTitle: Prediction of Friction and Wear of Sliding Electrical Contact Based on IPOA-KELM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Sliding contact and rubbing and wear in the bow net system will affect the life of the carbon skateboard. To predict the changes in the friction coefficient and wear rate in the bow net system, this article uses its homemade sliding electric contact test machine to carry out the flow friction and wear experiment. Inquire about the characteristics of the friction coefficient and wear rate under different operating conditions, and then proposed to improve the pelican algorithm optimization nuclear limit learning machine network prediction model. Using Tent chaotic reverse learning strategy, Sine and cosine algorithm strategy and adaptive t-distribution strategy to improve the Pelicans optimization Algorithm (POA), and verify the superiority of the Pelicans algorithm. Then use the improvement of the Pelican optimization algorithm (IPOA) to optimize the kernel extreme learning machine (KELM) parameters to verify that the accuracy of the predictive model is as high as 98.9<sup>%</sup>and 98.3%.

articleTitle: An Algorithm on Monocular 3D Object Detection Based on Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traditional 2D convolution approaches are inappropriate for capturing information about local objects and their scale changes. To better depict 3D structures, the fundamental concept behind it is to mix depth information with RGB data to understand 3D space via depth estimations for creating depth maps of 2D images. However, it places a great deal of reliance on the precision of depth estimate, which results in subpar performance. In this paper, a monocular 3D object detection algorithm is proposed to resolve the issues mentioned earlier. The algorithm depends on the estimation of depth, which is essential for accurately detecting objects using a single camera. To begin with, a Normalization-based Attention Module has been deployed to a backbone network with two branches to extract RGB and depth maps separately. To merge the RGB and depth map features, a depth-guided dynamic local convolutional module is subsequently implemented. Depth map learns exemplar kernels from RGB images using a weight learning submodule and dilation convolution. Then it acts locally on the corresponding RGB images to solve the scale-sensitive problem of objects. By utilizing this approach, it becomes possible to extract feature representations from 2D images and map them onto 3D space, minimizing the disparity between the 2D and 3D representations. Experiments indicate that under the moderate setting of the class car - which is the most significant level of the KITTI dataset - our method outperforms other cutting-edge algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Error Correction Method for Measurement of Rheological Properties of Mud under the Influence of Pulsating Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The performance of drilling fluid plays an extremely important role in oil drilling, in the drilling, the main functions of the drilling fluid including bottom hole cleaning, carrying cuttings, control and balance the formation pressure, etc., in the completion, the function of the drilling fluid protect the reservoir. The rheological property of drilling fluid is an important indicator parameter of drilling fluid properties, Conventional measurement method based on the well site to use paradigm six-speed viscometer to manual measurement, measurement time is too long, manual operation error, human cost and other issues, led to the drilling safety risk, In this paper, a real-time rheological measurement method of drilling fluid is proposed, which adopts two series of variable diameter measuring tubes. When the flow rate through the measuring tube, the shear rate and shear stress of the drilling fluid can be obtained by measuring the pressure difference between the two ends of the measuring tube, and the mathematical model can be used to improve the accuracy of viscosity detection, greatly shorten the measuring period, and realize the automatic measurement of drilling fluid rheology. However, because the pulse of diaphragm pump has influence on the pressure measurement of the pulsating flow rate of different pipe diameters, and the device uses the pipe pressure difference data to calculate the viscosity, so the error correction and analysis of the downward influence data of the pulsating flow rate are carried out, thus improving the accuracy of the device to measure the rheological property of drilling fluid.

articleTitle: Simulation of Casing Logging Based on Time Domain Electromagnetic Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper studies the numerical simulation of the time-domain electromagnetic method of cased-well. Firstly, the principle of the time-domain electromagnetic method of cased-well is briefly described, and the simulation design of the time-domain electromagnetic method is carried out by COMSOL finite element software. This model is a single-send and single-receive model, including the establishment of pulse waveform, receiving coil, instrument rod, borehole, casing, cement ring and stratum. Through the calculation of COMSOL finite element software, the induced electromotive force of the time-domain electromagnetic method model can be obtained. Through the analysis of the induced electromotive force and the extraction and analysis of these response information, the purpose of detecting the underground geological body can be achieved and the downhole situation can be effectively judged. In this study, the numerical solution calculated by COMSOL open-hole model was compared with the analytical solution, and the error was analyzed. The analysis error is derived from the skin effect through the analytical solution formula, which proves the correctness of the numerical solution. On this basis, casing is added for research. Finally, the response curves of open hole and casing well are compared under different formation conductivity conditions. And the transient response curve of casing well under different casing thickness and casing conductivity.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Parameter Sensitivity for High Frequency Eddy Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The process of detecting metal materials can be affected by factors such as the size of the eddy current probe and the magnitude of the current. High frequency eddy current sensors have been widely used in the detection of material internal flaws because of their advantages, such as a non-contact structure and relative speed. However, the process of detecting metal materials can be affected by factors such as these. This study analyzes the influence of measurement parameters such as the inner and outer radius and height of the coil, the number of coils and layers of the high-frequency eddy current structure on the measurement results through a combination of finite element simulation and experimental verification. Additionally, this study quantifies and discusses various factors affecting the measurement accuracy, and it proposes an optimization method for the high frequency eddy current structure. The purpose of this study is to address the issue of measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and System Design of Three-Dimensional Imaging Method of Drill Pipe Thread Based on Binocular Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: During the service process, the threads are subjected to various compound alternating stresses and long-term chemical corrosion environment, resulting in cracking defects such as fatigue and stress corrosion, which eventually lead to fracture failure of drilling tools due to the expansion of micro cracks. The depth information of the object is important for the fixed-point inspection of drill pipe threads. In this paper, we studied the principle of 3D imaging by binocular method, designed a 3D imaging and defect detection system for drill pipe threads based on dual image sensing modules, built an experimental platform for male thread imaging with adjustable baseline, set the baseline parameters as 169 mm, 84.5 mm, 35 mm, etc., and studied the influence of baseline on thread imaging. The experimental results show that the baseline has a large impact on the effect of 3D imaging of drill pipe in terms of defect detection. When the baseline is 169 mm, the imaging range is the largest and the amount of defect detail information is the least; when the baseline is 35 mm, the imaging range is the smallest and the amount of defect detail information is the richest. The results of the experimental study provide the basis for setting the baseline parameters of the dual image sensing module of the system.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Modeling and Simulation on Pulsed Eddy-current Testing for Inspecting Symmetrical Deformation Metal Casings
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Casing plays a vital role in the development of oil and gas wells. Various external factors including shrinkage and expansion and other forms of deformation that may occur seriously affect the normal production of oil and water wells. In order to improve the accuracy of casing deformation detection, the three-dimensional modeling and simulation analysis of symmetric deformation of metal casing based on pulse eddy current detection are studied in this paper and the three-dimensional magnetic field response under pulse eddy current detection is analyzed and simulated as well. The results show that when the probe is moved from the casing mouth to the bottom at different stages, its position in the center better displays the magnetic field information, thus determining the best receiver position of the probe and providing a strong reference value for the receiver setup.

articleTitle: Weak Current Signal Detection Device Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The current rapid development of weak electrical installations has made the monitoring of weak signals increasingly important. For highly sophisticated instruments, the slightest signal deviation will cause terrible and irreparable damage. At present, commercially available multimeters generally have low accuracy, which does not meet the error range required for weak electrical signal monitoring, because it cannot be monitored in real-time, and requires manual handheld data collection. To address the above demands, this study designs and builds a voltage and current signal collector based on the STM32F103 microcontroller. In this case, the DC voltage is designed in the range of −5 V to 5 V, and for the current is from 4 to 20 mA, and the AC voltage from 0 to 5 V can be measured. The measurement results will be displayed on the LCD screen. The collector uses RS485 as the physical transmission interface and the communication protocol uses the Modbus-RTU protocol, which can work properly in the range of 10–24 V DC supply. The analysis of the corresponding requirements is followed by the circuit design to complete the transmission and display of the collected data. The DC voltage measurement part contains the process of boosting and dividing the circuit and then reading it, the current measurement is completed by an isotropic proportional amplifier circuit, and the AC voltage RMS measurement uses the AD637 true RMS conversion chip to realize the circuit, the design contains the software part, the hardware part, and the communication part design. The final device has been tested to meet the national standard of maximum permissible error range within ±0.1 and is suitable for the complex environment envisaged.

articleTitle: Life Measurement Test of Full Ceramic Bearing Based on LABVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to study the life range and failure process of full ceramic bearings in a non-lubricated state, a set of full ceramic bearings life measurement system was designed in this paper. The main content of the experiment is as follow. First axial and radial vibration acceleration signals of full ceramic bearings are collected. Then root mean square analysis and envelope analysis are conducted on the test data. Finally, an optical microscope is utilized to observe the surface of bearing components, and analyze failure modes. Because the analysis results of measurement data are consistent with the actual observation results, it is proven that the measurement system can accurately measure the failure process of bearings.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Photovoltaic Inverter Parallel Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Microgrid technology based on photovoltaic distributed power generation is becoming more and more mature. With the rapid development of clean energy in China, its application will be more extensive. The control of parallel operation of inverters is very important to the stable operation of microgrid and the circulation control is the key to ensure the reliable operation of parallel operation of inverters. The working principle of three-phase photovoltaic inverter was analyzed in this paper. A master-slave control mode was proposed to control circulation of the parallel inverter system. The voltage and current double closed-loop control parameters was analyzed. The microgrid system was simulated by PSIM software. The simulation results show that the system circulation decreases from the maximum value of 0.16A to 1.4×10<sup>-8</sup>A after the control strategy is added. The voltage and current of three-phase output basically reach the requirement of balance. The control effect of the system circulation is obvious, and the simulation results meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Guidance and Control Method Based on Simulink Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, In order to solve the problem of poor precision of UAV cluster cooperative guidance, a Simulink model is designed based on dual-layer cooperative guidance architecture for verification. Firstly, a bias proportional guidance law with attack angle constraint is designed based on the relative motion relation of the target. Then, based on the sight coordinate system of the missile, the remaining attack time of the missile is estimated under the designed guidance law, and the co-bias proportional guidance law is designed. Aiming at the cooperative guidance problem, a robust control algorithm is designed to compensate the influence of unknown external disturbance and improve the robustness of UAV system. Finally, the Simulink model is designed according to the mathematical model, and the Simulink simulation is used to simulate the UAV cluster cooperative guidance under the conditions of no wind disturbance and wind disturbance. The experimental results show that the designed control law can realize the cooperative guidance of multiple UAVs, and has a good ability to resist external interference.

articleTitle: Line Spectrum Optimization Method Based on LSTM Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The instantaneous frequency obtained from the extraction of a spectrogram is not always accurate, and there may be issues with incomplete collection of spectrogram features. In order to solve this problem, a time series prediction method can be used to predict the possible frequency values at these moments. A spectrogram prediction method based on LSTM was proposed, using the current frequency and backward difference of the spectrogram as features, and the forward difference as the label. The predicted results were used as new features for iteration, and a series of spectrogram prediction results were obtained to correct the instantaneous frequency and make it more accurate. The effectiveness of this method was validated through open-source and real measurement data processing, providing a new solution for spectrogram optimization with practical application value.

articleTitle: Detection Technology and Safety Hazard Analysis of Lightning Devices in Gas Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article uses the lightning voltage pulse formula and rolling ball method to calculate and analyze the protection range and lightning voltage pulse waveform characteristics of the lightning arrester. This article analyzes the technical points of lightning protection installation and construction in the business hall, canopy, distribution room, refueling area, storage tank area and other areas of the station building from the aspects of direct lightning protection and induction lightning protection. It proposes the precautions for lightning protection device detection in each area of the gas station, emphasizes the daily management of lightning protection safety hazards, and ensures the stable operation of the gas station.

articleTitle: Chaotic Salp Swarm Algorithm for Inverse Kinematics of a 5-DOF Drill Floor Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As automation technology continues to advance in the global oil industry, intelligence is becoming a crucial trend. The focus of future research and development will be on reducing labor, minimizing operational risks, and enhancing work efficiency. The kinematics problem of drill floor robots is the basic problem for achieving intelligent operation, and inverse kinematics is the key problem for the kinematics solution. This paper focuses on the inverse kinematics solution of a drill floor robot that does not meet the Piper criteria. A modified Chaotic Salp Swarm Algorithm (MCSSA) is proposed for the robot. The algorithm utilizes Gaussian chaotic maps for population initialization and updates the salp leader positions, imitating the individual positions update mechanism of particle swarm optimization (PSO) to update the salp followers' positions. The improved method is used to calculate inverse kinematics solutions and is compared with classical PSO, Differential Evolution Algorithm (DE), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA) algorithms. The results show that the improved SSA algorithm performs better for inverse kinematics problems.

articleTitle: Development of Acquisition Device for Low Frequency Acoustic Signal Generated by Geotechnical Movement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to realize the monitoring of infrasound produced by rock and soil mass movement in the process of geological disaster evolution of landslide and debris flow, a capacitive infrasound sensor with wide band and high sensitivity is designed in this paper. The infrasonic sensor has the following characteristics: With wide frequency band, it can detect sound waves in the range of 0.1~100Hz, which covers most infrasound frequency bands and part of audible frequency bands produced by geological disasters of debris flow and landslide; A combination of acoustic filter and filter circuit is used to suppress signals, interference and noise outside the monitoring frequency band; Good frequency response, within the design frequency range, the response is straight; Wide dynamic range, the loudest pressure level can reach 108dB; High sensitivity, up to 11mV/Pa; Using a small mass of 6um thick diaphragm, can be insensitive to vibration; Small size, easy to carry; The container for the backing volume casting thickness of 12mm resin insulation, sustainable, stable and effective work.

articleTitle: Analysis of Near-site Vibration Characteristics of the Ms6.8 Earthquake in Luding, Sichuan, China
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The Ms6.8 earthquake occurred in Luding, Ganzi Prefecture, Sichuan Province, at 1252 h on 5 September 2022. 156 sets of strong-vibration acceleration records were obtained by the National Strong-vibration Observatory Network of China during this earthquake. In this paper, the relevant ground shaking parameters were calculated after baseline correction processing of the strong-motion records, and the spatial distribution of peak ground shaking acceleration (PGA) and acceleration response spectrum (Sa) were obtained using the kriging interpolation method. The results show that the long axis of the PGA spatial distribution is in the north-west-south-east direction, and the spatial influence field of Sa for different periods of ground shaking tends to extend towards the south-west and south-east of the epicentre in both directions.

articleTitle: Collaborative Search Planning of UAV Swarms Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In a multi-agent environment, efficient collaborative search among multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is crucial for area search and path planning. Therefore, it is important to consider the collaborative learning among UAVs when designing collaborative strategies. This paper analyzes the problems of existing value-decomposition-based multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms in multi-UAV area search and path planning, namely the underestimation of optimal joint actions, which leads to suboptimal policy generation. Subsequently, a new non-monotonicity value-decomposition algorithm is proposed based on the addition of a masked highway connection strategy. This algorithm suppresses the optimization of certain action pairs and focuses more on the optimal joint actions, thus better optimizing the objective and recovering the value of optimal joint actions. Multiple simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can achieve improved performance in environments involving UAV swarms and enhance the collaborative effectiveness of UAV swarms in search tasks.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Network in SCADA System Assisted Diagnosis of Oil Well Indicator Diagram
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the progress of oilfield development work, mechanical oil extraction has become the main oil extraction method in oilfields. Due to its unique working environment, oil well failures often occur, resulting in a decrease in production and efficiency. In response to the problems of multiple daily testing wells, one-sided manual and single diagnosis, and the inability to timely and effectively detect whether the oil well is normal, this article uses the classic model InceptionV3 of convolutional neural networks to train the convolutional neural network model by establishing indicator diagram training data for each working condition. During the model establishment process, the training parameters and sample set data are continuously modified, Finally, convolutional neural networks were implemented for auxiliary diagnosis in SCADA systems. Not only does it reduce labor intensity, but it also improves the efficiency and accuracy of indicator diagram diagnosis, achieving accurate analysis of oil well production dynamics and timely making correct adjustments.

articleTitle: Decision-Making of Phosphogypsum Treatment Based on Deepfm Recommendition System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The selection of a phosphogypsum yard treatment scheme has always been one of the key issues for phosphate fertilizer manufacturers in production and service work. The existing strategy is generally to organize expert scoring to complete the evaluation. However, the evaluation results are too subjective and often have significant uncertainty. Therefore, this paper takes intelligent recommendation systems as the core means to solve the uncertainty of the output results of existing methods. Thus, a treatment scheme recommendation system based on the DeepFM model is designed. For the scheme selection, we propose an expert scoring approach including scoring and confidence. Subsequently, a scheme recommendation strategy is proposed. In the application of real cases, it can be seen that the method proposed in this paper has obvious advantages in the recommendation of a phosphogypsum yard treatment scheme by comparing three common methods. That is, the scheme arrangement obtained through our method has a greater degree of differentiation, making it easier for decision-makers to select the best scheme.

articleTitle: Performance and Analysis of Composite Surface Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved U-Net by Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the problem of complex texture and smallness of defect in composite surface defect, this paper improved the detection model of features based on the U-Net architecture and a detailed analysis of the attention model is made. First, features contraction completed through the Encoder (the left path), then features expansion and recovery completed through the Decoder (the right path). The improved model introduces the channel attention model and the spatial attention model. The residual model is introduced to reduce the impact of network degradation and gradient disappearance on the model. Depth-wise separable convolution is introduced to lightweight the model. The results of comparative testing in ablation experiments show that the improved detection model can accurately identify defects, especially the smallness defect. It is much better if you place the channel attention in front of the spatial attention and selecting <tex>$7\times 7$</tex> as the kernel size of the convolution in spatial attention. The total pixel accuracy of the model detection in this paper reaches 95.42% and the intersection over the union (IoU) value of the proposed algorithm reaches 84.98% which can satisfy the effective identification of composite surface defect detection and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Design of Micro-environmental Humidity Measurement and Control System for Cultural Relics Display Case
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The relative humidity is one of the most critical indexes for the preservation of cultural relics. To maintain the stability of the humidity in the microenvironment of cultural relics display cases, this paper designs and develops a humidity measurement and control system for the micro-environment of cultural relics display cases based on the principle of direct mixing of air and water for hot and cold exchange, combined with embedded system and automatic control technology. Focus on solving the compressor-evaporator type refrigeration problem of frost and large fluctuations in the humidity of the display case, and the system for the limit value and stability test. The test results show that when the environmental temperature of the cultural relics display case is <tex>$25^{\mathrm{\circ}}\mathrm{C}\pm 2^{\mathrm{\circ}}\mathrm{C}$</tex>, the system can control the humidity of the display case in the range of 30%~70%, and the fluctuation and accuracy of the regulation and control are less than <tex>$\pm 1\%$</tex> when working for a long time, which meets the technical requirements of Chinese cultural relics protection industry standard for humidity regulation device.

articleTitle: A SAR ADC For Array Pressure Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A 12-bit single-ended successive approximation analog-to-digital converter (SAR ADC) is designed for the acquisition of multiple signals of pressure sensor arrays as well as for processing. The proposed SAR ADC has a bridge capacitor for the DAC to save chip area, uses a lower level board sampling technique to eliminate the effect of nonlinear charge injection and clock feedthrough on sampling, and uses a three-stage preamplification plus latch structure for the comparator to reduce kickback noise and introduces an output detuning storage technique to reduce comparator detuning and improve comparison speed. The circuit is designed using UMC 0.18um 1.8V CMOS process. Simulation results show that the designed SAR ADC can achieve an effective number of bits (ENOB) of 11.46 at 200kSPS sampling frequency with an average power consumption of 0.35mw, which can be applied to the front-end processing of signals from pressure sensing arrays.

articleTitle: Nondestructive Testing of Steel Wire Rope Inside Elevator Drawn Steel Belt
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traction steel belt is more and more used in the elevator. To realize its effective nondestructive testing, the eddy current testing technology is applied to the detection of broken wires in the steel belt. An array eddy current sensor is designed, which has 24 groups of array cylindrical coils, which are staggered on the upper surface and the lower surface of a steel strip, and two coils in each group form a detection model of an up-down symmetrical differential bridge. The differential bridge circuit reflects the damaged condition of the wire rope through the differential voltage output by the bridge. the key problems of wire rope detection are studied in depth, and the sensors and detection devices are manufactured. The experimental results show that the device can accurately and effectively detect the smallest broken wire of the steel wire rope inside the steel belt, that is, the fracture of the thin steel wire with a diameter of 0.20 mm, and can judge the damage of multiple broken wires.

articleTitle: Phase Identification Method of Low-voltage Distribution Based on Integrated Similarity and Secondary Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: According to the shortcomings of the phase identification method based on single voltage or power data, this paper proposes a phase identification method based on integrated similarity and secondary clustering. This method comprehensively utilizes two measurement data of voltage and power for integrated similarity measurement, which solves the problems of single voltage data method in three-phase voltage balance and single power data method in low power consumption of users. Firstly, the redundancy of the original data is reduced by voltage data filtering and power feature extraction. Then, the users are clustered for the first time by using the filtered voltage sequence to generate the in-phase user cluster. Finally, the integrated similarity combining voltage and power similarity is used to cluster the users for the second time to realize the phase attribution discrimination of the users in the low voltage distribution networks(LVDN). Compared with the single data algorithm, the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of phase recognition. Compared with the existing method combined with power optimization model, this method has stronger applicability in the case of partial user data missing.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Detection Method for Exterior Wall Spalling and Cracking under Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to study the anti-explosion performance of frame-supported SGP laminated glass, the dynamic response characteristics and failure mode of frame-supported SGP laminated glass under explosion were studied by field explosion test and dynamic nonlinear finite element analysis. The time history curve of explosion overpressure, failure mode of panel and dynamic displacement field were obtained through field explosion test and three-dimensional DIC analysis. The experimental results show that the crack distribution of frame-supported SGP laminated glass is mainly manifested as diagonal X-shaped crack and annular crack near the frame area under the action of explosion. The results of finite element analysis show that when td and panel natural vibration period T0 are of the same order of magnitude (0.1<td/ T0<10), ignoring the negative pressure area of explosion will significantly underestimate the peak of the reverse displacement of laminated glass, and can not predict the rebound failure, so as to overestimate its anti-explosion performance, resulting in unsafe design.

articleTitle: Research on the Testing Method of Fragment Motion Parameters with High-Speed Photography of Orthogonal Dual Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to obtain motion parameters of explosive fragments, a testing method of fragment motion parameters is proposed with high-speed photography of orthogonal dual camera. This method mainly includes three processes: fragment data collection, centroid coordinate calibration, and fragment coordinate calculation. The experimental results were compared with theoretical model established by aerodynamics. And the results showed that velocity values of large fragments can be obtained clearly in the experiment. Velocity values within the range of 1–3 meters are in good agreement with theoretical values, and velocity attenuation follows exponential decay law; Within a range of 3 meters from explosion center, dispersion trajectories of fragments are almost straight. The larger the mass and windward area of fragments, the faster the velocity attenuation, and the shorter the straight trajectory. This method can provide testing guidance for three-dimensional motion parameters of similar explosive fragments.

articleTitle: Investigation on Non-contact Measurement of DC Voltage Using Inverse Piezoelectric Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A non-contact DC voltage measurement method based on the principle of electric field coupling and inverse piezoelectric effect was proposed to solve the invasiveness and safety issues of contact measurement techniques on the original circuit. An experimental measurement system was built using a piezoelectric ceramic buzzer as a sensing probe. The results show that the measurement system can achieve non-contact DC voltage measurement, with a relative measurement error ≤3.33 % in the measurement range of 4.5~25 V. The measurement method proposed in the article eliminates the mechanical structure part of the traditional measurement method and has good research and application prospects.

articleTitle: Microwave Magnetic Field Detection in a Microwave Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Atomic microwave technology is a promising platform for quantum precision measurement and quantum information processing. However, experimental progress to date has been limited by microwave reflection interference in free space and the difficulty of temperature control. We report the development of high precision atomic microwave magnetic field measurement in standard microwave waveguides. Enabled by a reduction in reflected microwave interference and temperature frequency shift, our approach yields a significant improvement in microwave magnetic field measurement. We further show that the relationship between Rabi resonance profile and laser intensity, atomic vapor cell temperature and microwave intensity measured in microwave waveguide is confirmed to be accurate and reliable. These advances open up new prospects for quantum precision measurement and quantum sensing with alkali atoms.

articleTitle: Extraction of Timbre Features of Ethnic Plucked Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the existing timbre feature extraction algorithms are not targeted, the accuracy of extracted features is not high, and the characterization of features is not strong, a characterization strategy for the timbre features of ethnic plucked instruments is given, and based on this strategy, a timbre feature extraction scheme for ethnic plucked instruments is designed. The scheme first calculates the low energy and brightness of ethnic plucked instruments to obtain the time domain features of ethnic plucked instruments; then calculates the Constant Q Cepstral Coefficients of ethnic plucked instruments to obtain the frequency domain features of ethnic plucked instruments, and uses the obtained time domain features and frequency domain features of ethnic plucked instruments to represent their timbre features. The experimental results show that the timbre feature extraction scheme designed in this paper can effectively extract the timbre features of folk plucked instruments, and the extracted timbre features can better identify different folk plucked instruments.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Knowledge Graph Personalized Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, the use of knowledge graph and deep learning for recommendation has been widely studied and applied, but most recommendation models are incomplete in the representation of heterogeneous information items. Aiming at the extraction of high-order representations of user heterogeneous features and project features, a personalized recommendation model based on heterogeneous knowledge graph (HKGR) is proposed. The propagation of heterogeneous neural networks is used to model user preferences and project characteristics to improve recommendation performance. The accuracy of model recommendation is improved, and the ability of the model to cope with data sparse scenarios is enhanced. The experimental results show that the key components in this method are compared with the co-field baseline method, which is conducive to improving the recommended performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Static Load Response of FsFBG Embedded in Carbon Fiber Composite Laminates
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, the fsFBG sensor was embedded in the carbon fiber composite laminate, and the static load experiment was carried out on the carbon fiber composite laminate, and the response characteristics of the fsFBG sensor under different loading distances and different loading angles were analyzed. Experiments show that the fsFBG sensor can monitor the load change well, and the absolute value of the central wavelength variation decreases linearly with the increase of the distance of the loading point, and increases linearly with the increase of the angle between the loading point and the axial direction of the grating.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Injection Test System Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to meet the functional safety test requirements of CAN (Controller Area Network) bus in automobile electronic communication network, an automatic test technology based on fault injection is proposed based on the general bus test method and the characteristics of CAN protocol. By defining and configuring the registers of the embedded board, an automatic hardware test equipment for fault injection is developed. The CAN simulation software sends fault injection control commands to the embedded device, which verifies the accuracy and significance of the equipment automation technology design scheme.

articleTitle: HMT: An EEG Signal Classification Method Based on CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive measurement method commonly used to measure human brain electrical activity,It detects weak electrical signals generated by neurons in the cerebral cortex by placing electrodes on the scalp. These signals reflect the bioelectricity activity of the brain when thinking, perception, emotion, behavior and other activities.It has been used to measure the electrical activity of the human brain. The EEG signal can reflect the changes in the brain waves of the human brain, it is widely used to help doctors diagnose neurological diseases such as motor neurons, Parkinson's disease, and spasms. Low signal-to-noise ratio and high nonlinearity are the characteristics of EEG signals, which bring great challenges and difficulties to the analysis and recognition of EEG signals. Convolutional neural network is a great breakthrough technology in deep learning, which can deal with highly nonlinear and noisy data, and can automatically learn the distribution characteristics of EEG data and the classification of EEG signals. Compared with traditional EEG signal classification methods, the convolutional neural network has great potential in dealing with complex EEG signals. In this paper, a deep learning algorithm model HMT based on CNN architecture is proposed to process EEG signals, and its application in EEG signal classification and recognition is discussed.

articleTitle: Real-Time and Uniform Feature Filtering for Stereo Images Based on Spatial Indexing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: For mobile robots' or vehicles' navigation in dynamic environments, visual odometry is an effective technique to get precise locations at a lower cost. The feature-based method now becomes the typical solution, but it requires heavy computational power in filtering good features and matches. This paper presents an efficient pipeline to detect, filter, and match the features for stereo cameras based on AGAST, BEBLID descriptor, and spatial indexing. We use two quadtrees to manage features and filter good matches by stereo line searching and quadtree querying. The algorithm is evaluated on the KITTI dataset and greatly outperforms a mainstream feature filtering method using an image grid, KNN, and Lowe ratio test in terms of inlier ratio, uniformity, and real-time processing. The improved pipeline is well suited for a full stereo visual odometry or visual SLAM system.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Pantograph Net Sliding Electrical Contact Based on ISOA-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article uses a self-made sliding electric contact experimental machine to simulate the contact state of trains under actual operating conditions, and obtains the changes in the relative stability coefficient, current efficiency, and wear rate of current carrying under different pressure loads, contact currents, and sliding speeds. Based on the experimental results, a BP neural network prediction model was established with pressure load, contact current, and sliding speed as inputs, and current carrying relative stability coefficient, current efficiency, and wear rate as outputs. In response to the shortcomings of the BP neural network prediction model, the parameters of the BP neural network were optimized using the improved seagull optimization algorithm based on Tent chaotic mapping, adaptive control factor, and differential operator. The results show that the prediction models established by this algorithm have high accuracy and good generalization ability, providing reference for further research on the application of pantograph catenary sliding electrical contact prediction modeling.

articleTitle: Coal Mining Automatic Control Equipment Surge Immunity Test Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes a test method for evaluating the surge shock immunity of electronic equipment and systems. The test method involves subjecting the equipment to a series of controlled surge shocks and evaluating its performance and functionality during and after the shocks. The paper describes the experimental steps involved in the test method, including the selection of test equipment, test setup and configuration, and the application of surge shocks. The results of the test are analyzed and rectified using statistical analysis and case analysis to provide insight into the performance of the equipment under different surge shock conditions. The proposed test method provides a reliable and repeatable means of evaluating the surge shock immunity of electronic equipment and systems and can be used to guide the design of equipment and systems for use in challenging environments.

articleTitle: A Receiving Gain Monitoring and Dynamic Regulation Method for High Frequency RFID System with Dense Tags
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) system is widely used in archives management, intelligent warehousing, and other industries due to the advantages of insensitivity to liquid, controllable reading range and high reading density. However, in the application scenario of dense tags inventory, the position of the tags relative to the readers is different and dense tags are coupled with each other, so the intensity range of the tag response is wide. To ensure that all tags can be inventoried exactly, the readers are required to have a high dynamic range. In this paper, considering the relationship between receiving gain and anti-collision flow, a method of receiving gain monitoring and dynamic regulation for high-frequency RFID systems is designed. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the dynamic range of the reader on the premise of ensuring the efficiency of inventory.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Online Abnormal Load Identification Method Based on AOA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, the requirements of power system for load monitoring in the substation area are increasing. Aiming at the problem of abnormal load identification under the background of unknown household appliances load, this paper proposes a non-invasive on-line identification method for charging load of electric vehicles based on AOA-SVM. Firstly, the multi-dimensional features are sorted and screened by reliefF algorithm to get the optimal feature subset. Then, the arithmetic optimization algorithm (AOA) is used to optimize the parameters c and gamma of the support vector machine, and the AOA-SVM classifier is obtained. Finally, the anti-jitter mechanism is used to filter out the false alarm events and accurately identify and detect the charging load of electric bicycles at home. The real data obtained in the low-voltage area are used for experimental verification, and the experimental results prove that the method in this paper has good applicability and accuracy under the background of unknown household appliance load.

articleTitle: Belt Tear Detection Algorithm Based on Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the high precision and fast response monitoring requirements of conveyor belt defect monitoring system, a machine vision belt tearing detection algorithm based on template matching and affine transformation is proposed. This paper by analyzing the threshold range of the laser line in the gray distribution histogram, the position information of the key points in the laser line matching detection image is taken as the feature point. The affine transformation uses the information to do translation, rotation and other operations on the detection image, and then the detection image and the template image are differenced. The difference result is used as the basis for judgment. When the result is greater than the given threshold, the belt is judged to be tearing. The experimental results show that the accuracy of this algorithm is 96 %, and the detection time of a single image is 26 ms. Compared with the existing algorithms, both the detection time and the detection accuracy are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Flight Control System for Quadrotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A four rotor UAV flight control system is designed. First, the dynamic system model of the four rotor UAV is established, including the Kinematics equation, dynamic equation, and system control distribution model. Then, based on the dynamic system model, a double closed loop control system is designed, in which the attitude loop is the inner loop of the control system, and the position control loop is the outer loop of the control system. Finally, MATLAB software is used for experimental simulation verification, Set up two operating conditions: wind interference and unmanned interference, then compare and analyze the simulation results. The experimental results show this four rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight control system has strong anti-interference ability and meets the requirements of engineering design standards specially.

articleTitle: Measurement and Assessement of Road Poor Interlayer Bonding Assessment Using Ground Penetrating Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper attempts to combine deep learning and 3D ground penetrating radar (GPR) technology to achieve automatic location and classification of road poor interlayer bonding distresses. Based on the characteristics of poor interlayer bonding distress from GPR images, this work analyzes the improved methods of classic you only look once (YOLO) detection model, including residual network structure, focus structure, spatial pyramid pooling structure, etc. GPR image data set of poor interlayer bonding was established, the improved model YOLOX was designed, and the model was trained and tested on the data set. Results illustrated that the accuracy rate and recall rate of poor interlayer bonding recognition were 91.2% and 88.9%, and the AP and F1 score were 89.7% and 90.1%, respectively Compared with other mainstream models, the proposed model greatly improves the detection performance.

articleTitle: Laser Doppler Vibration Signal Demodulation Algorithm and FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The laser Doppler vibrometer has been widely used in many fields. Generally, the fast Fourier transform is widely used in vibration signal demodulation. However, this method has limitations in resolution, high computational complexity, requires high signal stability, and is non-real-time. To address the above problems in the laser Doppler vibrometer demodulation algorithm, this paper proposes a fast and real-time Doppler vibration signal demodulation algorithm, and designs a Doppler vibration signal acquisition and analysis system based on the FPGA platform. The pulse interleaved cancellation heterodyne method is used to achieve fast, real-time, and accurate laser Doppler demodulation. Through experiments on a standard vibration source, the feasibility of this method is verified. Compared with the fast Fourier transform, this method has lower computational complexity, higher real-time performance, and faster response.
