articleTitle: A Fano Resonance Sensor-Based Structure Constructed of a Toroidal Cavity Structure with Three Geometrical Voids
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: At present, with the booming development of optical technology, the requirement for compactness and integrativeness of optical instruments is becoming more and more urgent. Surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) have great potential applications in integrating optical circuits and subwavelength photonic devices. In this entry, we raised a late-model optical sensor structure based on Fano resonance, consisting of a Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) wave-guide and a circumferential cavity with three rectangular cavities (TCRC). Theoretical analysis of sensor characteristics by finite element method. The origin of Fano resonance generation were researched, and the effects of various structural features on Fano resonance and sensor sensing characteristics were analyzed. The maximization of transducer sensitivity this framework is 1660 nm/RIU and the figure of merit (FOM) was 63.8.

articleTitle: Research and Systematic Implementation of Interactive Configuration Method Based on SSD Primitive Extension Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The topological relationship of the conducting equipment and the information on the size and location of the primitive are defined in the Intelligent Substation System's Specification Description Document (SSD), but the layout rules for drawing the graphics of various types of conducting equipment are not clear, the information on the drawing of each conducting equipment is not comprehensive, and the SSD based on the SCL language are unreadable<sup>[1]</sup>. Therefore, it is difficult to visually verify the accuracy and integrity of configuration information, which makes it harder for construction and debugging. In this paper, standard primitives of various types of conducting equipment in SVG format are constructed, and the method of finding out the topological relationship of conductive equipment in the bay is studied by using the connection information between the devices in SSD. The layout rules of substation drawing, such as incoming line bay string, outgoing line bay string and bus, are given to construct the primitive extension model on the basis of completing the primitives' information of conducting equipment in SSD. In this paper, an interactive configuration scheme of intelligent substation's primitive extension model is proposed, which integrates the interactive configuration system based on SSD primitive extension model, and achieves the interactive configuration of all substation's graphic information and the automatic drawing of equipment's single-line diagram. Ultimately, in this paper, the feasibility of the scheme and the effectiveness of the system are verified through a practical example of an intelligent substation, which improves the intelligent substation's efficiency and accuracy in the construction and debugging.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Identification Technique for Networked Microgrids Based on Hyperlink-Induced Topic Search
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Networked microgrids, characterized by their widely distributed resources, offer substantial location flexibility. However, their diverse application domains and complex construction environments often necessitate the employment of various power supply modes, thereby escalating the challenge of power stability maintenance. To enhance the reliability of networked microgrids, it is imperative to investigate precise identification techniques for system vulnerability. Taking into these considerations, this paper proposes an effective technique for identifying weaknesses in networked microgrids. The input impedance matrix is decomposed into three components: a positive weight matrix R, a positive weight matrix L for inductive parameters, and a negative weight matrix C for capacitive parameters. The identification technique is then formulated based on this decomposition, utilizing the hyperlink-induced topic search algorithm for analysis and weight combination. Through analysis of the results, the weaknesses of the networked microgrids can be identified. This identification provides crucial insights for optimizing the design and operation of networked microgrids.

articleTitle: Ventilation Equipment and Facility Reliability Analysis Based on Evidence Theory and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article proposed a new solution through the combined use of evidence theory and neural network method for the evaluation of the reliability of the mine ventilation equipment and facilities. First, the outputs of multiple BP neural network serve as the basic probability distribution function of the evidence theory, after which the results are fused according to the rules of evidence combination, from which the security degree of the ventilation system can be figured out. The example shows that the evaluation results by this method are reasonable and objective, and very effective for the reliability evaluation of mine ventilation equipment and facilities. In light of the output instability of single BP neural network, we can select multiple BP networks, and through the comparison of the uncertainty degree of different lines of BP network after their fusion, we are able to analyze the impact of the selected lines of BP network on network instability.

articleTitle: AGC Method of fossil-fuel power station Based on Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the process of automatic generation control (AGC), it is difficult to achieve the optimal setting of generator parameters, resulting in a certain deviation between the control effect and the ideal state. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid genetic algorithm based AGC control method for fossil-fuel power station. Combined with the relationship between the generator operation mechanism and the overall output of fossil-fuel power station, a generator power system model is constructed to quantify the load change caused by 1% frequency change. In the process of implementing AGC control, hybrid genetic algorithm is introduced, and single step learning and multi-step learning actions are set respectively. When the difference between the two learning results is constant, the corresponding parameter values are taken as the setting results of the generator, so as to achieve AGC control in fossil-fuel power station. According to the test results, the upper and lower limits of the regulating capacity of the power plant under the designed control method change linearly with the change of the regulating capacity efficiency coefficient, which is consistent with the ideal control effect.

articleTitle: Development on Fast Carrier Synchronizer for Continuous Wave Mud Pulse Telemetry
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A fast carrier synchronizer with adaptive loop bandwidth is proposed for continuous-wave mud pulse telemetry systems, designed to achieve rapid carrier phase recovery and minimal steady-state phase jitter. The proposed synchronizer combines an extended Kalman filter and an adaptive bandwidth switching algorithm, allowing for dynamic loop bandwidth adjustments based on the loop lock state. This results in reduced convergence time during the capture state and decreased phase jitter in the tracking state. Simulation outcomes demonstrate that the proposed approach enhances convergence speed by a factor of ten compared to a conventional phase-locked loop, all while maintaining low residual phase noise.

articleTitle: Research on Gait Analysis and Control of Quadruped Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Quadruped mobile robots have broad application prospects and research significance, especially in fields such as industrial production, emergency response and disaster relief. A gait analysis method and control strategy for quadruped robot is proposed. The structural of the quadruped robot is analyzed. The single leg has active 3-DOF, namely hip rolling DOF and hip pitching DOF, and knee pitching DOF. The kinematics analysis is carried out and kinematics equations are obtained, the workspace of the foot end is gained. The foot trajectory is planned, and the driving equation of each joint is obtained based on the kinematics model. The simulation experiment is conducted, the movement of the leg is simulated, and the significance and rationality of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Coordinated Control of Relative Positions in Spacecraft Formation Based on Homogeneity Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a cooperative control law for fixed-time relative position coordination of spacecraft formation was designed based on the homogeneity theory. The control law includes a new type of integral sliding mode that is initialized at the origin. The designed control law ensures that once the system state leaves the sliding mode surface, it will return to the sliding mode surface within a fixed time. The fixed-time convergence of the system was proven based on the homogeneity theory.

articleTitle: Detection of Prostate Capsule Based on Attentional Mechanism and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The insufficient feature extraction ability of the network will lead to the decrease of the detection precision of the object detection. A new attention mechanism feature fusion network based on channels was proposed to solve that. We added Primary Component Analysis Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks (PCA-SENet) block to the backbone network VGG16 to increase the feature extraction ability, down-sampling and lateral connections were utilized to finish low-level and high-level feature fusion, new model called PCA-SENet Neighbour Single Shot Multibox (PNSSD) was proposed. The results showed that the proposed method had the mAP for prostate capsule image detection reached 82.02%, attention mechanism and feature fusion are helpful to improve the detection precision of object detection network.

articleTitle: Noncontact Intelligent Vibrometer Based on Laser Triangulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Effective vibration measurement is crucial for monitoring the health of mechanical systems and preventing failure. Current methodologies face limitations such as mass loading, signal attenuation, and environmental sensitivity. This paper presents a novel noncontact laser triangulation vibrometer (LTV) based on the laser triangulation principle for vibration measurements. The LTV offers rapid sampling, high precision, compact design, and easy integration, addressing the challenges faced by existing techniques. Validation experiments, including low-frequency tests on a piezoelectric actuator and high-frequency tests on a speaker diaphragm, demonstrate the LTV's high accuracy, repeatability, and adaptability in vibration measurement applications. Results show that the LTV can measure vibrations up to 45 kHz, and can achieve a low residual nonlinearity of ± 0.0121% F.S. and a low noise RMS of 0.549 μm. The proposed LTV provides a high-performance alternative to traditional vibration measurement methods for monitoring machinery health, diagnosing faults, and reducing maintenance costs.

articleTitle: A Method for Detecting Temperature Anomalies of Disc Suspension Insulators on Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Coupled with the extensive application of infrared thermal imaging technology in intelligent fault diagnosis of insulators on the transmission line, current image processing algorithms struggle to effectively identify the abnormal hot spots in infrared images of insulators. To cope with this problem, this paper proposes a lightweight model based on the ShuffleNet V2 network, which is based on the key point detection algorithm of the Gaussian heat map and embedded with efficient channel attention (ECA) mechanism to accurately locate and identify the iron cap area in the infrared image of insulators. After detecting the position of the insulator's iron cap, Hough straight line detection algorithm is used to combine the attitude of the insulator string, and then extract the thermal information of the insulator iron cap area. The model takes floating-point operations per second (FLOPs), memory consumption, model size, average precision (object keypoint similarity)-AP (OKS), and inference time as evaluation indexes. The experimental results demonstrate that the FLOPs size of the model is 4.65×107, the model size is 11.72 M, and the average precision reaches 93.39%. The memory consumption is 22.98 M and the inference time is 1.60 s when deployed and tested in Raspberry Pi. In comparison with the existing methods, the model achieves a sound balance between detection precision and inference velocity, meets the needs of edge equipment deployment, and provides a new solution for improving the inspection efficiency of the transmission line system.

articleTitle: Design Study of Constant Power Type Liquid Flow Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The constant power thermal mass flow meter measurement method is a very important reference for the measurement of parameters related to low fluid production wells. This paper presents an idea for the design of a constant power- based oil and water two-phase flow measurement for measuring the flow of tiny liquid flows. Experimental practice to test the flow detection characteristics of the designed constant power flow meter. The results show that this constant power thermal flow meter has good sensitivity for stable low flow measurements with a small relative error.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study of Flexible Microwave Ablation For Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Microwave ablation (MWA) is a cancer treatment that uses microwave energy to ablate malignant tumors, which is minimally invasive and highly effective with few side effects. Under bronchoscopy guidance, MWA can be a feasible non-invasive treatment modality for the central lung cancer growing on one side of the bronchus. In this paper, a flexible directional water-cooled antenna was proposed for the first time for lung cancer trans-bronchially. A numerical model of MWA in lung with the antenna was built based on porous media tissue of lung. Then, the model was used to simulate the ablation performance of the proposed antenna with the treatment protocol of 45 and 60 W for 10 min. The simulation results show that the antenna designed in this paper has a good performance of directional ablation of lung tissues.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient Artificial-Noise Optimization for Secure Multi-Beam Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Transmit Beamforming and artificial noise (AN) methods have been widely employed to achieve wireless physical layer (PHY) secure transmissions. At present, most of the work is focused on optimizing transmit beamforming, with relatively little emphasis on the design of artificial noise projection matrix (ANPM). In this paper, compared with traditional ANPM obtained by zero-forcing method, which lacks efficiency and rationality for AN power distribution. This paper aims to prevent known eavesdroppers intercepting useful signal as far as possible and achieve a narrower bit error rate (BER) main beamwidth under the premise of limited AN power consumption. The distribution of AN power in all directions is optimized by minimizing the AN transmit power subject to a series of SINR constraints. Finally, simulation results Eves can be seriously affected by the AN with regard to power efficiency performance.

articleTitle: Surface Roughness Prediction Method of Milling Based on NCA-SAE
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Roughness is a critical parameter to characterize the quality of surface processing. To improve the prediction accuracy, a novel NCA-SAE feature fusion method is proposed for surface roughness prediction in milling process. Based on the manufacturing signals collected in milling process, NCA is applied for feature selection to screen out the features that are more sensitive to the surface roughness, while the feature fusion to eliminate redundancy and complementarity between features in time and space is carried out by SAE. The key parameters of NCA-SAE method are optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO). The milling experiment is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the improved method. The results show that the obtained roughness model based on NCA-SAE obtains the best prediction effect.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Algorithm Based on Transformer+CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: CNN and Transformer have their own excellent performance in image super-resolution, but these methods are difficult to be applied to the field of image SR alone due to the challenges of balancing model performance and complexity. To address these issues, we propose a Transformer+CNN-based algorithmic model for image super-resolution. First, a channel attention module is added to the model framework to model the correlation between channels of the feature maps; second, different training strategies are used to fine-tune the parameters at the end of the network base training; finally, a new loss function is introduced to optimize the parameters in the fine-tuning phase. The experimental results show that the method is more effective than the excellent algorithms in recent years.

articleTitle: Development of a Shear Stress Measurement Device for Subsea Soils
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a typical shear strength measurement device for subsea soils, the vane shear instrument cannot detect the mechanical characteristics of deep soils. There is no appropriate non-contact measurement method for its main parameter, torque. The structure of the vane shear is enhanced in this research, and a torque sensor based on the inverse magnetostrictive effect is devised. The theoretical analysis is used to build the mathematical relationship between torque and sensor output, and the impacts of parameters such as coil gap and shaft diameter on sensor output characteristics are examined in combination with comsol software simulation and practical experiments. Torque sensors with 10mm and 14mm diameter Permalloy shafts, the sensitivity of 0.8mV/Nm and 1.8mV/Nm, and maximum relative error of 0.114% and 1.262%, respectively, were built. Eventually, the developed shear stress measuring device was compared to the vane shear instrument, and the measurement results were almost identical, proving the device's viability. The device designed in this article has a simple construction and strong linearity, and it provides a novel approach to measuring shear stress in deep-sea soils.

articleTitle: A Gas Emission Prediction Model Based on IQPSO Algorithm Optimized KELM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To improve the prediction accuracy and efficiency of gas emission from the mine retrieval workings, a kernel-based extreme learning machine (KELM) gas emission prediction model based on the improved quantum particle swarm optimization (IQPSO) algorithm is established. Redesigning the particle evolution equation in the QPSO algorithm, and the regularization coefficient and kernel parameters of KELM are optimized using the IQPSO algorithm to enhance the adaptive nature of the prediction model. The factors influencing the amount of gas emission are screened for principal component analysis processing and used as model inputs for gas gushing prediction. The proposed model is compared with QPSO-KELM and PSO-KELM models, and the results show that the error of the proposed model is controlled within 0.15 m<sup>3</sup>/ min, with an average relative error of 0.81%, and the prediction accuracy is 9 and 16 times better than other models. It proves that the IQPSO-KELM model has higher prediction accuracy and efficiency for the prediction of gas emission.

articleTitle: Prediction of Photovoltaic Power Based on BP Neural Network Optimized by Improved Equilibrium Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: China is building a power system based on new energy, of which photovoltaic power generation is an important part. If the prediction model of photovoltaic power can be established accurately based on meteorological data, the development of photovoltaic industry will be further promoted. Aiming at the problems of slow convergence speed and easy to fall into local extremum of traditional BP neural network model, this paper uses piece wise linear chaotic map (PWLCM) and hyperbolic tangent (HT) to improve equilibrium optimizer (EO), and optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network model (IEO-BP) to predict the photovoltaic power. The training data of the model is selected from a photovoltaic power station in northwest China. In order to avoid the impact of redundant data on the accuracy of the model, the correlation coefficient is used to analyze the data. Compared with traditional BP and EO-BP neural network, experimental results show that IEO-BP can obtain a more accurate photovoltaic power prediction model.

articleTitle: Multi-USV Target Search Algorithm Based on Markov Prediction Model in Ocean Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Unmanned boat swarms are a modern type of marine intelligent equipment with broad applications in ocean observation, maritime patrol, and search and rescue. This paper proposes a cooperative target search strategy for USVs based on the ant colony optimization algorithm to optimize the search trajectory in the marine environment, thereby improving search efficiency and task robustness. The proposed algorithm is simulated in various search scenarios and compared with other heuristic algorithms to verify its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Pest Identification System Based on YOLOv5s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Pests are inevitable in agricultural production. In recent years, China has lost 40.0 million tons of grain annually due to various pests, accounting for 8.8% of the total. In the nature, there are more than 1 million known insect species, which are complex and diverse. It is inefficient and wasteful to identify pests manually. Using the deep learning network of computer vision to identify pests can effectively solve this problem. This paper mainly introduces the network structure of YOLOv5s algorithm, and designs a multimodal pest identification system based on YOLOv5s algorithm, which can carry out real-time video monitoring and picture recognition. In the training model stage, a variety of data enhancement algorithms are used to train the optimal model, and the average identification accuracy of the optimal pest model can reach 97%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Self-Cycle Measurement System for Sonar Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a kind of precision instrument equipment, the sonar detector needs to be tested repeatedly during the product design process and prelaunch before the formal launch. The accuracy and time of the test using the manual operation standard instrument are difficult to meet the requirements. Aiming at the above problems, a set of automatic recycle test system based on PXI measurement equipment is designed. The design principle, hardware design method and test software design flow of different parts of the equipment are introduced. In the calculation of sampling signal amplitude and frequency, the self-power spectrum function is introduced to simplify the calculation process. For the development of CAN communication software module, a rapid creation method of CAN session handle based on Database Editor mechanism is proposed, and CAN communication is realized by stream mode, which improves the data receiving rate. Using this test system to test the sonar detector, it has the advantages of convenient operation, short detection period, and automatic repetition of key test items, which plays a good role in the design and use of sonar detector.

articleTitle: Method to Estimate the Moisture Content of On-board Traction Transformer in EMUs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Moisture is a crucial factor that significantly impacts the insulation condition of oil-paper insulation in transformers. In engineering practice, the moisture content of insulation paper is primarily obtained indirectly using moisture equilibrium curves and moisture calculation models of oil-paper insulation. The aging status of insulation paper exhibits discernible impacts on its moisture absorption characteristics. In this study, the widely adopted moisture calculation model in engineering and related research, i.e., the Fessler model, was optimized by considering the influence of the aging status. Furthermore, the optimized model was verified by comparing the calculated results with experimental data. The optimized model provides a fundamental basis for further research and practical applications in engineering.

articleTitle: Safety Detection of Fiber Grating Anchor Sensors Based on Dual-Strategy Combination Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A safety detection model of FBG anchor sensors based on BiLSTM combined with optimization is proposed for the safety of mine anchors. Firstly, the FBG anchor sensor model is designed and field installation experiments are conducted to extract the safety detection feature parameters of the FBG anchor sensor; for the hyperparameters that cannot be directly determined in BiLSTM, the genetic algorithm (GA) coupled with the Skyhawk Optimizer (AO) optimization algorithm is used to optimize the hyperparameters at the initial time; and the feature parameters are dimensionally reduced by kernel principal component analysis (KPCA). The final experiment proves that this FBG anchor sensor safety detection model has high average accuracy and low standard deviation, and the proposed method can effectively improve the safety detection rate of FBG anchor sensors.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Finite Element Numerical Simulation of Ground - Well Transient Electromagnetic
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ground-well transient electromagnetic method is a variant of surface transient electromagnetic method. Different from conventional ground-well exploration scheme, it uses ungrounded loop to send excitation, and the observed parameter is the shaft component of response, which is more suitable for deep exploration work. In this paper, a ground-well exploration model is established based on the three-dimensional forward modeling theory of electromagnetic method, and the finite element software COMSOL is used to numerically simulate the transient electromagnetic response of thin plate conductors under different conductivity and different sizes, so as to provide help for the qualitative interpretation of electromagnetic data in Wells. The results show that the change of the longitudinal conductance of the thin plate conductor does not affect the shape of the anomaly, but the anomaly range and diffusion velocity decrease with the increase of the conductivity value. The abnormal response varies with the size of the thin plate conductor. Therefore, the known drilling information and geological information should be fully combined in the actual work.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for Nonlinear State-Constrained Systems with Time-Varying Delays and Unknown Control Direction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive tracking control strategy for nonlinear state-constrained systems subject to time-varying delays and unknown control direction. In the backstepping process, the challenges of time-varying full state constraints and time-delays are solved by combining the time-varying barrier Lyapunov functions (BLFs) with the Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals (LKFs). The Nussbaum function and neural networks (NNS) are used to handle the unknown control direction and approximate the unknown functions, respectively. The satisfactory tracking performance can be achieved without violating state constraints under our presented control method. Finally, the simulation study is implemented to illustrate the feasibility of the presented method.

articleTitle: An Experimental Study of Two-phase Moisture Measurement Method Based on Microwave
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the continuous development of petroleum development technology toward intelligence, unmanned and simplicity, the traditional downhole water content measurement technology can no longer meet the needs of current petroleum development. Therefore, a new SDR-based contactless downhole crude oil water content measurement method is proposed in this paper. In this paper, an indoor detection system is established and an experimental study is carried out using SDR equipment. The effect of distance on water content measurement by SDR equipment is analyzed, which proves the feasibility of this new detection method and provides technical support for the water content measurement of crude oil downhole in horizontal wells.

articleTitle: Electricity Consumption Data Online Cleaning Based on Robust Subspace Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To cope with anomalous disturbances and noise caused by, for example, meter faults and communication errors during acquisition and transmission, a subspace learning method is proposed based on separated low-rank regularization to uniformly achieve noise reduction and outlier rejection of electricity consumption data. On the one hand, the low-rank electricity consumption data matrix is constructed based on the intrinsic spatiotemporal correlation of single-user electricity consumption behavior, and the bilinear factorization is used to replace the nuclear norm to realize the separable rank minimization regularization constraint, which lays a key foundation for online algorithm application for massive electricity consumption data; on the other hand, the optimization problem of adaptive multi-norm joint regularization constraint with forgetting factor is constructed based on the intrinsic correlation of separable rank minimization with subspace tracking and learning, and the alternating optimization is used to realize online cleaning of massive electricity consumption data. Numerical simulation tests of electricity consumption data in real situations confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and its superior performance compared to other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on Acceleration Signal Denoising of Press Slide Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In view of the noise interference existed in the acquisition process of press slider acceleration signal, based on the actual experimental data of press slider, a method of Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and Wavelet Transform (WT) combined data noise reduction is proposed to separate the effective signals. Finally, the superiority of this method is verified by comparing it with VMD noise reduction alone and WT noise reduction alone. It shows that the joint algorithm can filter out noise more effectively, improve quality, facilitate feature information extraction, and provide a new idea for signal noise reduction processing.

articleTitle: Stress Measurement of Thin-Walled Parts Based on SH Guide Wave EMATs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ultrasound is widely used for non-destructive testing to measure stress. In comparison to piezoelectric ultrasound, electromagnetic ultrasound provides benefits such as non-coupling and non-contact, and it can measure stress in complex on-site environments. Shear-Horizontal (SH) guide wave is one of the important waveforms propagating in thin-walled parts, which can still exist in zero-order symmetric mode in long-distance propagation. However, most studies now use SH guided waves to measure defects, few studies use SH guided waves to measure stress. Hence, a stress measurement model for a periodic permanent magnet electromagnetic acoustic transducer (EMAT) is established in this paper based on the advantages of SH guided wave propagation in thin-walled components. After that, a finite element model of a periodic permanent magnet electromagnetic acoustic transducer is developed to study the propagation law of SH guided waves. Finally, the designed SH guided-wave periodic permanent magnet EMAT is used to conduct tensile stress measurement experiments, and the test results showed that the measured stresses were in good agreement with the real stresses, which verified the feasibility of the designed transducer and measurement method.

articleTitle: A Method for Correction of Drilling Pressure and Torque Parameters in Small Boreholes
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A parameter correction model is developed to address the problem of inaccurate measurement of follow-through parameters during drilling of small boreholes. First, the drilling pressure and torque parameter measurement model is established by the principle of drilling pressure and torque parameter measurement. Subsequently, the drilling pressure test rig and torque test rig are used to obtain the measurement data of drilling pressure and torque parameters. Finally, the measured data are fitted and corrected by least squares method, gradient descent method, and regularized linear regression method. Field experiments have confirmed that the data fitting method allows for the correction of drilling pressure and torque parameters in small boreholes with drilling.

articleTitle: Design of a Control System for Precision Two-Dimensional Positioning Platform of Small Desktop Scanning Electron Microscope
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a control system is designed for the precision two-dimensional positioning platform in small desktop scanning electron microscope. The positioning platform is driven by a stepper motor, and the control system contains control circuit and control program. RS485 protocol or Ethernet is adopted by the system to communicate with the host. The system realizes the functions of position closed-loop control, S-sharped speed curve control and error compensation for the stepper motor to achieve the target of easy operation with a stable, rapid and high-precision position. The experimental results show that the platform that adopted this control system could get the accuracy of the X-axis is <tex>$\pm 7.88\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, the repeated positioning accuracy of the X-axis is <tex>$\pm 3.21 \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex>, the positioning accuracy of the Y-axis is <tex>$\pm 5.28\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, and the repeated positioning accuracy of the Y-axis is <tex>$\pm 4\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, which meets the requirements of precision two-dimensional worktable in small desktop scanning electron microscope.

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network Prediction of Optimal Exhaust Pressure of Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The widespread application of heat pump technology presents significant growth opportunities for the heat pump industry. As the demand for high temperature heat pumps in industry rises, compound high temperature heat pumps and transcritical heat pump systems are gaining increasing attention. Due to their critical operating characteristics, heat pump systems currently possess the optimal exhaust pressure in terms of energy efficiency. This paper uses experimental data as the basis for the calculation and fitting of the optimal pressure, and employs an artificial neuron network scheme to analyze the correlation between the influence of the system state parameters and the optimal exhaust pressure, in order to better solve the problem of maintaining the system in a high energy-efficient operating condition under variable operating conditions. The impact of genetic and particle swarm algorithms on the outcomes is also incorporated to the artificial neuron network. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the particle swarm optimised neural network has superior generalisation properties.

articleTitle: A Feature Defusion Network for Surface Anomaly Detection of Industrial Products
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a feature defusion network for industrial product surface anomaly detection. This method addresses two prominent issues in industrial product surface anomaly detection tasks: the presence of complex textures on the surface of the product to be inspected and the scarcity of anomaly samples. In our network, two variational autoencoders are used as the main branch network, and the similarity loss is applied to separate the texture features and structural features of the sample data in the latent space. Then, an external anomaly classifier is used to detect the structural features. We conducted a set of comparative experiments to validate the effectiveness of this method in anomaly detection tasks of this kind, and the results show that this method can meet the detection requirements of industrial production very well.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: An improved method is presented to solve the problems of local optimum and poor real-time performance of conventional artificial potential field method on route planning of unmanned surface vehicles. This method introduces a new repulsive potential field function and adds a regulatory factor. In order to limit the active area, the boundary repulsion field is introduced. By adjusting the boundary repulsion factor and the adjustment factor, the algorithm can be better prevented from falling into local optimum and the optimization efficiency can be improved. This method is simulated in Matlab and compared with traditional algorithms. The test results show that compared to traditional algorithms, using this method for path planning can shorten the range by 3.1%, have a relatively small curvature, reduce the turning point by 33.3<sup>%</sup>, and have a smoother path, which has broad application prospects.

Author Keywords: Potential field function of repulsive force

articleTitle: Optimization of Outdoor Long-Range Localization Algorithm Based on DS-TWR
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Currently, The UWB positioning system utilizing the DS-TWR algorithm has a high communication conflict rate in multi-tag environments. It can generate significant ranging errors when used at long distances. An enhanced algorithm has been proposed to tackle these issues. Regarding communication, the hash distribution of the communication content of the label and the base station is carried out, and then the base station responds uniformly to reduce the number of messages sent by the base station. In terms of range, an adaptive Kalman filter algorithm is proposed to improve range accuracy. The results show that the collision rate of communication is reduced by about 51 %, and the accuracy of ranging is reduced by about 76 % compared with that without filtering.

articleTitle: Development of Urban Air Quality Monitoring Network Based on Immobile and Mobile Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Air quality is of great importance to social production and life health. Systematic air quality monitoring is the baseline for preventing air pollution. The purpose of this paper is to propose a suite of the fine-grained monitoring network using the coverage model introduced, based on existing air quality stations (AQS) and low-cost immobile and mobile sensors compared to conventional methods which only used AQS, air quality micro-stations (AQMS) or mobile air quality monitoring stations (MAQMS) to monitor. Without loss of generality, we take Beijing city as an example. A heuristic algorithm is used to simulate the coverage of monitoring sensors when considering AQS, AQMS, MAQMS, and alternatives. Two indices are compromised between construction cost and surveillance accuracy. The integer multiple-objective programming is applied to assess various combinations of air quality monitoring methods. Numerical calculations are performed, which prove the efficiency of the above-mentioned strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Expansion Method for Temperature Measurement of Electromagnetic Heated-Cigarettes Device
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Electromagnetic heated-cigarettes device generates heat through electromagnetic induction in order to heat tobacco. However, due to the small surface area of the heating element, which is located in the shielding cavity wrapped by the induction coil, it is difficult to achieve accurate temperature measurement, which leads to the difficulty of quality control of electromagnetic heated-cigarettes device and the large temperature difference of the device, and it is difficult to ensure the user's smoking experience; According to the thermal characteristics of metal materials, the detection platform of electromagnetic heated-cigarettes device is designed, which is not only suitable for small surface, shielding cavity and electromagnetic environment, but also does not change the structure of heated-cigarette device. The results show that the thermal properties of 1J85 and 1J50 Permalloy show a linear relationship in the range of <tex>$200^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> to <tex>$400^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>, and the temperature can be measured by measuring the elongation of the material; The thermal properties of 1J79 and 4J36 Permalloy are nonlinear, which can be used to detect the elongation of materials at fixed point temperature. If the material has linear thermal characteristics, the measured temperature error of each batch of cigarette device is <tex>$\leq 3^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>; Or if the material has nonlinear thermal characteristics, the measured elongation error of each batch of cigarette device at the fixed point temperature (such as <tex>$350^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>) is <tex>$\leq 0.02\text{mm}$</tex>, which can ensure the consistency of the heating temperature of the electromagnetic heated-cigarettes device for quantitative production and ensure the product quality of the device.

articleTitle: Fast Digital Self-Interference Cancellation based on Adaptive Momentum Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the co-frequency and co-time transceiver processing system, the transmitted signal will leak into the receiving channel to form the self-interference, resulting that the useful reception signal be distorted. In order to promote the self- interference cancellation capability in digital domain, the adaptive momentum gradient descent algorithm is proposed in this paper, which combines the exponentially decaying historical gradient and current gradient estimation together to update the weight coefficients of adaptive filter, which can reduce the impact of noise and accelerate the convergence velocity. Finally, the simulation demonstrates that convergence velocity of the proposed algorithm can be speeded up more than 4 times faster than the traditional stochastic gradient descent algorithm, and the self-interference cancellation capability can be up to 51 dB when ADC is 10 bits.

articleTitle: Differential Noise Prediction Modeling for Power Line Carrier Communication Based on Accurate Classification and Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Establishing a simple and accurate noise prediction model for power line carrier communication is important for system reliability and further optimization of power line communication performance. In this paper, we propose a differential noise prediction modeling for power line carrier communication based on accurate classification and identification to achieve accurate prediction of power line carrier channel noise by using the good time-frequency domain localization characteristic of wavelet neural networks (WNN). Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively identify different noise types and achieve high-precision predictive modeling of power line carrier noise.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Control Technology in Steam Flooding
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Liao he Oilfield has been developed for many years, especially with the continuous expansion of the development scale of heavy oil blocks. With the extension of development time, the management difficulty of heavy oil wells is also increasing. With the continuous advancement of digital oil fields, many software and advanced management methods have emerged in recent years aimed at improving the level of oil production management and improving the efficiency of heavy oil well systems. However, due to the cyclical variability of thermal recovery development in heavy oil fields, software developed based on traditional thin oil development theory is not suitable. Therefore, oil production management and mechanical recovery parameter adjustment always remain at the level of manual calculation and regulation. In order to meet the needs of digital oilfield development and improve the timeliness of regulation, on-site testing of the digital oil production intelligent control system has been carried out. Field testing has been conducted on the steam drive well group in Block Du 229, which can achieve intelligent regulation of oil well mechanical production parameters, improve oil well production efficiency, ensure safe production of oil wells, reduce labor intensity, and have far-reaching significance for comprehensive application in heavy oil thermal recovery wells.

articleTitle: Analysis Method about Elevator Acceleration Based on 5G Mobile Phone
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In response to the problem of elevator safety measurement, a method was proposed to use the built-in accelerometer of an Android phone to measure the acceleration of the elevator operation. A method was also proposed to reduce the measurement acceleration noise based on the Kalman filter and the feasibility of the Kalman filter in noise reduction of such data was demonstrated, verifying the correctness of the measurement scheme.

articleTitle: A New Parallel Cascade Pulse Emission Technique Based on Avalanche Triodes
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Avalanche transistors have been widely used in pulse generation devices due to their unique avalanche characteristics. In this paper, a special parallel cascade structure is designed in view of the shortcomings of the high amplitude of the Mark cascade circuit composed of avalanche transistors, such as the need for a multi-cascade cascade and the multi-stage circuit cannot be triggered at the same time due to the avalanche triode production process, so that the entire circuit is triggered simultaneously under the Direct Current (DC) power supply conditions of the critical avalanche voltage value, resulting in a signal quality significantly better than the high amplitude of the same stage Marx circuit, and the pulse signal with narrow pulse width. The principle of the avalanche effect is analyzed in this paper, and then the working principle of the avalanche triode cascade circuit is described, and the modified parallel cascade circuit is introduced on this basis, and the simulation analysis and physical experiments can be used to obtain negative pulses with an ascending edge of 1.9 ns, a pulse width of 4.25 ns, and an amplitude of about 300 V. The results show that the performance of the modified pulse generator device is well improved.

articleTitle: A Publicly Available Multimodal Emotional Dataset Triggered by Both Videos and Odors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study investigates multimodal emotion signal recognition by using odors as a stimulus material to explore the influence of the odor on human emotions. It is conducted in the context of traditional electroencephalography and electrooculography fusion for emotion recognition. We designed an experimental paradigm involving visual, auditory and olfactory senses, adding odors to traditional audiovisual medias to enhance emotion elicitation, and built a multimodal emotion dataset. The dataset contains electroencephalography and electrooculography data obtained from 15 subjects in video-odor stimulation and video-only stimulation experiments. 90 video clips and 10 odors were selected as stimulus materials. Besides, the Transformer classifier was adopted to classify the three categories of emotion, and give the average classification accuracy for the different features. Under differential entropy features, the multimodal average classification accuracy under video-odor stimulation was 3% higher than that under video-only stimulation. The results indicated that olfactory stimuli can be combined with video stimuli to enhance multimodal emotion recognition ability.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Cementing Pump Skid Based on Full-automatic Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The fully automatic double machine double pump skid is a new generation of skid cementing equipment designed for deep water drilling platform, which integrates the latest control technology, explosion-proof technology and safe and reliable design concept. The complete set of equipment is composed of a main skid with explosion-proof function and a remote control room with remote integrated monitoring function. The operator can complete pressure test, pumping and other operations in the remote control room. On the basis of the existing equipment configuration, a large number of automatic modifications are carried out to realize the hardware conditions of high automation of equipment. At the same time, through a large number of traditional cementing pump pressure test operation, mixing operation, pipeline cleaning operation and so on, the automation of the whole cementing process is realized. After many tests, the overall stability of the field operation and remote operation system was verified. The cement slurry density fluctuated around plus or minus 0.02S.G, and the ability to lower the ash, pump pressure and flow rate were all effective, which verified its applicability and stability. The successful development of automatic cementing pump skid speeds up the process of digital and intelligent transformation of cementing equipments and tools, and lays an important foundation for the core problem of the whole-process cementing technology.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Resolution Performance of Microwave Near-field Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Based on the principle of near-field microwave testing, a simulation analysis of the equivalent model of the probe sample was carried out, and the spatial resolution of a probe with a needle tip radius of <tex>$20\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> was calculated. Subsequently, a near-field scanning microwave microscope system was constructed, and a group of Cu thin films with decreasing widths and a group of Cu thin films with increasing thicknesses were tested. The profile curves obtained from scanning were analyzed to obtain the probe's different resolutions in the lateral and depth directions. Combined with the basic theory in the field of near-field microwave, a method for measuring the spatial resolution of the probe was proposed, laying the foundation for further research on near-field scanning microwave microscopes.

articleTitle: YOLOv5-SC: A Lightweight Detection Model for Railway Catenary Dropper
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, railway enterprises hope to add intelligent detection functions to their detection equipment, realizing the intelligence of railway detection to solve problems such as low efficiency in traditional manual detection methods. However, due to limitations in the performance of mobile devices, it is difficult to deploy network models with large amounts of computation and weight parameters on mobile devices. Based on the YOLOv5 network model, this article proposes the YOLOv5-SC model for railway catenary dropper location detection, which has less computation and smaller network model size while still maintaining good detection accuracy. Through experimental comparison, the lightweighted network model has a small decrease in detection accuracy, and YOLOv5-SC network model size and computation are half that of the original YOLOv5 network model, with an improved detection speed by14.5<sup>%</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Characteristics of Electromagnetic Signal in Downhole
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to evaluate the transmission characteristics of electromagnetic signal of EM-MWD system in downhole, a novel theoretical model for prediction the transmission capacity of electromagnetic MWD system has been developed. Firstly, the theoretical model of electromagnetic signal transmission channel in downhole is established with drill string, casing, drill-bit, drilling fluid and formation being taken into account. Secondly, the model is analyzed in detail with COMSOL multiphysics platform. The simulation result shows that(i) the amplitude of received electromagnetic signal attenuates obviously with the increase of transmission depth;(ii) formation resistivity also has a great influence on EM-MWD transmission depth. Extremely high or low formation resistivity is not conducive to the transmission of electromagnetic signals. In addition, conductivity, inner radius and thickness of drill string also has a certain impact on the transmission of electromagnetic signal. The simulation model can be applied to predict the transmission capacity and transmission depth of electromagnetic MWD system.

articleTitle: Data Processing Method for Ultrasonic Draft Detection of Inland River Ship
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper designs an ultrasonic-based draught detection system for inland ship, using an ultrasonic transducer array to construct multiple ultrasonic relative paths in the waterway and using the diffraction effect caused by the ship's occlusion of ultrasonic for draught detection. In order to reduce the interference of underwater noise on the detection results, the system uses the median average filtering algorithm to filter the signal from the receiving transducer array and obtains the receiving transducer real-time amplitude matrix. The system uses the transducer amplitude matrix marking algorithm based on variable threshold and the amplitude subdivision method based on polynomial fitting to process the amplitude matrix, and then calculates the ship draught by combining with the real-time liquid level data analysis, which effectively suppresses the effect of random noise on the detection results. The experimental results show that the standard deviation of the detection data is less than 2cm, and the system is able to achieve off-ship detection and meet the accuracy requirement of draught detection.

articleTitle: Research On 3D Face Recognition Based on Deep Learning Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the problems of insufficient 3D face data, high acquisition costs and low recognition accuracy, this paper proposes a framework of 3D face recognition algorithm based on deep learning reconstruction. Firstly, two-dimensional face features are extracted by High Resolution Network (HRNet), and the reconstructed three-dimensional face is obtained by using Graph Convolutional Network (GCN). Feature matching is completed using the loss function proposed by Arcface to recognise the reconstructed 3D faces. Using 2D face recognition assistance for 3D face recognition, the similarity between the 2D face and the reconstructed 3D face is weighted to improve the problem of face recognition being affected by complex environments. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the 3D face recognition algorithm based on deep learning reconstruction is 95.83%, and the recognition effect is better than that of 2D face recognition alone as well as 3D face recognition alone.

articleTitle: Research on an Intelligent Structure for Push Control of Multi-Center Cloud Data Pool
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The intelligent control of complex system must first solve the problem of data calculation, application and real-time support, which is not only the difficulty and focus of control system design, but also the key to artificial intelligence and intelligent manufacturing. It is found that the essence of control system are both processing data and controlling the direction of data flow. So, the connotation of intelligence lies in an open data processing system to increase the control of data flow, thus forming the basis of real-time data processing. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent push control structure of multi center cloud data pool. The structure takes multi-layer cloud data pool as the center, vertical cloud data pool processes global parameters, and uses block chain technology to keep data synchronization. Horizontal cloud data pool collects status data by different function, and parameters required by control loop are pushed by cloud data pool. So, cloud computing ensures the separation of data computing and control, and multi-layer cloud data pool can form sensor networks. The structure realizes the intelligent control target of complex large-scale system that can not only implement big data calculation, but also control the flow direction of data.

articleTitle: Design of 120GHZ FMCW Radar Liquid Level Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In mining, petroleum, food and other production fields, it is necessary to measure the liquid in the container and determine the height of the liquid level in the container. In this paper, a 120GHZ FMCW radar liquid level measurement scheme is proposed to solve the corrosivity problem in the process of liquid level measurement. In this paper, the working principle of FMCW radar is analyzed and sawtooth wave is selected as the modulation signal of radar input. The sawtooth modulation signal generation module, radar sensor module, filtering and amplifying module, ARM controller STM32 processing module and signal processing module are designed. The difference frequency signal processing algorithm of FMCW radar is introduced, and FFT algorithm and CZT algorithm are simulated and compared. Simulation results show that CZT algorithm can improve measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Reliable Aggregation Method of Power Line Communication Subcarriers in Complex Power Electronic Colored Noise Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of smart grid construction, massive power electronic devices have been widely used in power system. However, the large-scale access of power electronic devices makes the power electronic colored noise interference more complex in power information communication network. To address the above problem, this paper constructs the colored noise coexistence spectrum knowledge graph to achieve comprehensive and accurate evaluation of the subcarrier life cycle for power line communication (PLC). Then, a highly reliable carrier aggregation method based on subcarrier life cycle evaluation is proposed to improve the communication rate and save bandwidth resources. The simulation results show that this method has excellent performance.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Method of Small Sample Weak Signal Based on Wavelet Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the insufficient number of training samples provided to the neural network-based weak signal detection model leads to the failure of the method, a small sample weak signal detection method based on wavelet data augmentation and long-short-time neural network is proposed. Data augmentation is achieved by adjusting wavelet parameters for wavelet denoising to generate new data to achieve the number of training samples with high robustness and high detection accuracy that can fully learn the characteristics of signal samples based on neural networks. By adjusting the wavelet denoising parameter amplification parameters, the performance indicators obtained by applying the weak signal detection model to the comparative study are obtained, and the wavelet denoising parameters that can be used for the effective amplification of weak signal samples are obtained. The simulation results show that among the wavelet analysis denoising parameters, the selection of wavelet basis function and the selection of threshold function have little effect on the amplification generated data set, while the wavelet decomposition reconstruction layer parameter can only select from 1 to 3 layers of wavelet decomposition and reconstruction, otherwise the model is invalid. Under the condition of -10dB signal-to-noise ratio, the detection method of weak signals can reach more than 90% when the training sample data is sufficient, and the detection accuracy of small samples of weak signals based on wavelet data augmentation and long-short neural networks can achieve 80% detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Infrared Spectroscopy of Alkane Gas Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The advantages of infrared spectroscopy analysis method are safe, effective, fast, pollution-free, and low-cost, which perfectly meets the current industrial measurement and measurement needs. In this paper, the infrared spectra of various elemental alkane gases are treated by random forest algorithm combined with multiple pretreatment schemes. Firstly, the number of components and concentration labels of alkane gas in the dataset are analyzed for manual data division, and three pretreatment methods have been selected: principal component analysis, Lowess smoothing method and S-G smoothing method, and two parameters in the random forest are fixed, and the regression prediction of ethane low concentration components is carried out by combining three pretreatments. S-G smoothing method is preferred to be the optimal pretreatment method. Then, S-G smoothing is used as the preprocessing to optimize the two parameters of the random forest. It is concluded that the optimal parameters are optimal when the number of decision trees is 300 and the number of leaves is 4, and the low concentration components of ethane are best predicted, with <tex>$\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.9991$</tex> and <tex>$\text{RMSE}=4.1495$</tex>.

articleTitle: Processing and Analyzing Drilling Tools Information by NI DIAdem Software
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To promote the digital and intelligent development of the oil and gas industry, an automatic data analysis scheme is proposed to solve the problems of large amounts of drilling data, mainly relying on manual analysis and process duplication. This article focuses on a tool information processing program created by NI DIAdem, which automatically analyzes and identifies the tool's status based on input data and can generate reports. The designed program can import data from different file formats, convert it to a unified standard format, and store it in DIAdem. According to the characteristics of the data, the program will use the established classification model based on logistic regression to screen and classify the data and then process the data according to the predefined mathematical way. Finally, the processing results will be saved in the preset report to achieve the effect of data visualization and decision-making aid and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: An end-to-end Lithium Battery Defect Detection Method Based on Detection Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The DETR model is often affected by noise information such as complex backgrounds in the application of defect detection tasks, resulting in detection of some targets is ignored. In this paper, AIA DETR model is proposed by adding AIA (attention in attention) module into transformer encoder part, which makes the model pay more attention to correct defect information. Rather than the noise information on the image, so as to improve the detection ability of lithium battery surface defects. Experiments show that AIA DETR model can well detect the defect target of lithium battery, effectively reduce the missed detection problem, and reach 81.9% AP in the lithium battery defect data set

articleTitle: The Experimental Study of High speed Shear Valve Pulser Telemetry System in MWD
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: China Oilfield Services Limited(COSL)'s indigenous “XUANJI” system, is China's first rotary steerable drilling and logging while drilling system, allows real-time analysis of formation data to greatly reduce the cost of oil and gas field development. Since it was put into use, the “XUANJI” system has been operating all over China's four seas as well as Xinjiang, Shanxi and other land oil and gas fields, and has completed high-difficulty drilling for many times. It has successfully achieved 1,000 Wells and a total drilling penetration of 1 million meters, and the key operating indicators have reached the world-class level. The speed of data transmission is crucial in the process of “XUANJI” system operation, so it is necessary to develop a high speed mud pulse data transmission system while drilling. In this paper, the principle of the high-data-rate measurement while drilling(MWD) telemetry system based on the swing valve is introduced, and the influencing factors in the mud pulse telemetry are analyzed. The key technologies in the development of the high-data-rate MWD transmission system, such as the drive system design, the control scheme, the modulation and the method of noise reduction are given, and the development idea of the high-data-rate MWD telemetry system is clarified. The actual drilling test shows that this system can achieve 12bps transfer rate at 3000 meters depth. It indicates that the technical indicators are reasonable, technical route is correct and the implementation is available. The successful research and development of the high-data-rate MWD telemetry system will fundamentally solve the data rate bottleneck of the Drilog® & Welleader® system. The design and technical analysis have a certain guiding role for the research and development of such drilling tools.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID Control of Parallel 6-DOF Motion Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to solve the control problem of the parallel 6-DOF motion platform, a fuzzy controller is designed to self-tune the PID control parameters, and a fuzzy PID controller is formed to control the actuator electric cylinder. SimMechanics/Simulink are used to establish the simulation model of the parallel 6-DOF motion platform, and the traditional PID control and fuzzy PID control are used to its control respectively, and the comparison is made. The research shows that the parameter self-tuning fuzzy PID control method has good control accuracy and response speed.

articleTitle: Vibration Control of Tunneling Equipment Based on Magnetorheological Elastomeric Dynamic Vibration Absorber
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to reduce the vibration of the cutting part of the continuous miner, firstly, a coupled dynamics model of cutting part with magnetorheological elastomer dynamic vibration absorber (MREDVA) is established, and the vibration reduction mechanism of MREDVA is analyzed; secondly, an MREDVA structure applicable to the tunneling equipment is designed, and its frequency-shifting characteristics are obtained through simulation; Thirdly, for different coal seam characteristics, the amplitude attenuation is used as an index to compare the vibration reduction performance of MREDVA under different current strengths; finally, the semi-active control algorithm is established based on the vibration reduction results under different current strengths. The results show that the control effect of the semi-active MREDVA is significantly better than that of the passive MREDVA, and the amplitude attenuation can be improved to 45.1% under complex working conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Invert Monitoring System of Expansive Rock Tunnel Based on Distributed Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The technical condition of the civil structure of the tunnel is deteriorating, so it is necessary to monitor the invert structure of the tunnel for a long time, so as to find and eliminate the hidden dangers of road traffic in time. The research on tunnel deformation monitoring technology has been carried out at home and abroad, but the research on using distributed optical fiber to monitor the invert of expansive rock tunnel is still few. In view of this, this paper establishes an invert monitoring system based on distributed optical fiber in expanded rock tunnel to monitor the stress characteristics of the surrounding rock of the tunnel basement, so as to timely discover the hidden dangers of road traffic safety.
